ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P1-S3.text: In his latest book, Doing Our Own Thing: The Degradation of Language and Music and Why We Should Like, Care, John McWhorter, a linguist and controversialist of mixed liberal and conservative views, sees the triumph of 1960s counter-culture as responsible for the decline of formal English.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P1-S3.translation: 约翰·麦克沃特（John McWhorter）是一位混合了自由主义和保守主义观点的语言学家和争议主义者，在他的最新著作《做我们自己的事：语言和音乐的退化以及为什么我们应该喜欢、关心》中，他认为 20 世纪 60 年代反主流文化的胜利是正式英语衰落的原因。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P1-S4.text: Blaming the permissive 1960s is nothing new, but this is not yet another criticism against the decline in education. Mr. McWhorter's academic speciality is language history and change, and he sees the gradual disappearance of "whom", for example, to be natural and no more regrettable than the loss of the case-endings of Old English.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P1-S4.translation: 指责宽松的 20 世纪 60 年代并不是什么新鲜事，但这并不是对教育衰退的又一次批评。麦克沃特先生的学术专长是语言历史和变迁，他认为“whom”的逐渐消失是很自然的，并不比古英语格结尾的消失更令人遗憾。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P1-S5.text: But the cult of the authentic and the personal, "doing our own thing", has spelt the death of formal speech, writing, poetry and music.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P1-S5.translation: 但对真实和个人的崇拜，“做我们自己的事情”，已经注定了正式演讲、写作、诗歌和音乐的消亡。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P2-S1.text: While even the modestly educated sought an elevated tone when they put pen to paper before the 1960s, even the most well regarded writing since then has sought to capture spoken English on the page.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P2-S1.translation: 虽然在 20 世纪 60 年代之前，即使是受过中等教育的人在落笔时也会寻求更高的语气，但即使是自那时以来最受推崇的写作，也试图在纸上捕捉英语口语。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P2-S2.text: Equally, in poetry, the highly personal, performative genre is the only form that could claim real liveliness.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P2-S2.translation: 同样，在诗歌中，高度个人化的表演体裁是唯一可以声称真正生动的形式。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P2-S3.text: In both oral and written English, talking is triumphing over speaking, spontaneity over craft.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P2-S3.translation: 在英语口语和书面语中，谈话胜过口述，自发性胜过技巧。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P2-S4.text: Illustrated with an entertaining array of examples from both high and low culture, the trend that Mr. McWhorter documents is unmistakable.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P2-S4.translation: 麦克沃特先生用一系列来自高雅文化和低俗文化的有趣例子进行了说明，他所记录的趋势是明确无误的。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P2-S5.text: But it is less clear, to take the question of his subtitle, why we should, like, care.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P2-S5.translation: 但就他的副标题“为什么我们应该关心”的问题来说，还不太清楚。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P3-S1.text: As a linguist, he acknowledges that all varieties of human language, including non-standard ones like Black English, can be powerfully expressive—there exists no language or dialect in the world that cannot convey complex ideas.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P3-S1.translation: 作为一名语言学家，他承认所有种类的人类语言，包括像黑人英语这样的非标准语言，都可以具有强大的表达能力——世界上不存在不能传达复杂思想的语言或方言。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P3-S2.text: He is not arguing, as many do, that we can no longer think straight because we do not talk properly.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P3-S2.translation: 他并不像许多人那样认为我们不能再正常思考是因为我们说话不正确。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P3-S3.text: Russians have a deep love for their own language and carry large chunks of memorized poetry in their heads, while Italian politicians tend to elaborate speech that would seem old-fashioned to most English-speakers. Mr. McWhorter acknowledges that formal language is not strictly necessary, and proposes no radical education reforms – he is really grieving over the loss of something beautiful more than useful.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P3-S3.translation: 俄罗斯人深爱自己的语言，脑子里有大量背诵的诗歌，而意大利政客则倾向于阐述对大多数英语国家来说似乎过时的演讲。麦克沃特先生承认，正式语言并不是绝对必要的，并且不建议进行激进的教育改革——他真的对失去一些美丽而不是有用的东西感到悲伤。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P3-S4.text: We now take our English "on paper plates instead of china".
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P3-S4.translation: 我们现在把英语“放在纸盘上而不是瓷器上”。

ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P3-S5.text: A shame, perhaps, but probably an inevitable one.
ky-en1-2005-r-t4#P3-S5.translation: 也许是一种耻辱，但可能是不可避免的。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S1.text: In spite of "endless talk of difference," American society is an amazing machine for homogenizing people.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S1.translation: 尽管“无休止地谈论差异”，美国社会仍然是一台令人惊奇的使人们同质化的机器。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S2.text: There is "the democratizing uniformity of dress and discourse, and the casualness and absence of deference" characteristic of popular culture.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S2.translation: 流行文化具有“服装和言论的民主化统一，以及随意和缺乏尊重”的特征。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S3.text: People are absorbed into "a culture of consumption" launched by the 19th-century department stores that offered "vast arrays of goods in an elegant atmosphere.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S3.translation: 人们被19世纪的百货商店所开创的“消费文化”所吸引，这种文化“在优雅的氛围中提供种类繁多的商品”。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S4.text: Instead of intimate shops catering to a knowledgeable elite" these were stores "anyone could enter, regardless of class or background.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S4.translation: 这些商店不再是迎合知识精英的私密商店，而是任何人都可以进入的商店，无论阶级或背景如何。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S5.text: This turned shopping into a public and democratic act." The mass media, advertising and sports are other forces for homogenization.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S5.translation: 这将购物变成了一种公共和民主的行为。”大众媒体、广告和体育是同质化的其他力量。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S6.text: Immigrants are quickly fitting into this common culture, which may not be altogether elevating but is hardly poisonous.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P1-S6.translation: 移民正在迅速融入这种共同文化，这种文化可能并不完全令人振奋，但也绝非有毒。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S1.text: Writing for the National Immigration Forum, Gregory Rodriguez reports that today's immigration is neither at unprecedented levels nor resistant to assimilation.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 格雷戈里·罗德里格斯在国家移民论坛上撰文称，当今的移民既没有达到前所未有的水平，也没有抵制同化。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S2.text: In 1998 immigrants were 9.8 percent of the population; in 1900, 13.6 percent.

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S3.text: In the 10 years prior to 1990, 3.1 immigrants arrived for every 1,000 residents; in the 10 years prior to 1890, 9.2 for every 1,000.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S3.translation: 1990年之前的10年里，每1000名居民就有3.1名移民抵达； 1890年之前的10年，每1000人中有9.2人。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S4.text: Now, consider three indices of assimilation—language, home ownership and intermarriage.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S4.translation: 现在，考虑三个同化指标——语言、住房所有权和通婚。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S5.text: The 1990 Census revealed that "a majority of immigrants from each of the fifteen most common countries of origin spoke English 'well' or 'very well' after ten years of residence." The children of immigrants tend to be bilingual and proficient in English.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S5.translation: 1990 年的人口普查显示，“来自 15 个最常见原籍国的大多数移民在居住十年后都能说‘流利’或‘非常流利’的英语。”移民的孩子往往会说双语并且精通英语。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S6.text: "By the third generation, the original language is lost in the majority of immigrant families." Hence the description of America as a "graveyard" for languages.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P2-S6.translation: “到了第三代，大多数移民家庭都失去了原来的语言。”因此，美国被描述为语言的“坟墓”。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P3-S1.text: By 1996 foreign-born immigrants who had arrived before 1970 had a home ownership rate of 75.6 percent, higher than the 69.8 percent rate among native-born Americans.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 到 1996 年，1970 年之前抵达的外国出生移民的住房拥有率为 75.6%，高于本土出生的美国人 69.8%。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P3-S2.text: Foreign-born Asians and Hispanics "have higher rates of intermarriage than do U.S.-born whites and blacks." By the third generation, one third of Hispanic women are married to non-Hispanics, and 41 percent of Asian-American women are married to non-Asians.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: 在外国出生的亚洲人和西班牙裔人“异族通婚率高于在美国出生的白人和黑人”。到了第三代，三分之一的拉美裔女性与非拉美裔女性结婚，41% 的亚裔美国女性与非亚裔女性结婚。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P3-S3.text: Rodriguez notes that children in remote villages around the world are fans of superstars like Arnold Schwarzenegger and Garth Brooks, yet "some Americans fear that immigrants living within the United States remain somehow immune to the nation's assimilative power." Are there divisive issues and pockets of seething anger in America?
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P3-S3.translation: 罗德里格斯指出，世界各地偏远村庄的孩子都是阿诺德·施瓦辛格和加斯·布鲁克斯等超级明星的粉丝，但“一些美国人担心生活在美国境内的移民在某种程度上仍然不受国家同化力量的影响。”美国是否存在分裂问题和愤怒情绪？

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P3-S5.text: It is big enough to have a bit of everything.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P3-S5.translation: 它足够大，什么都有一点。

ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P3-S6.text: But particularly when viewed against America's turbulent past, today's social indices hardly suggest a dark and deteriorating social environment.
ky-en1-2006-r-t1#P3-S6.translation: 但特别是与美国动荡的过去相比，今天的社会指数很难表明社会环境黑暗且不断恶化。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S1.text: Stratford-on-Avon, as we all know, has only one industry—William Shakespeare—but there are two distinctly separate and increasingly hostile branches.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S1.translation: 众所周知，埃文河畔斯特拉特福只有一个行业——威廉·莎士比亚——但有两个截然不同且日益敌对的行业。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S2.text: There is the Royal Shakespeare Company (RSC), which presents superb productions of the plays at the Shakespeare Memorial Theatre on the Avon.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S2.translation: 皇家莎士比亚剧团 (RSC) 在埃文河畔的莎士比亚纪念剧院上演精彩的戏剧作品。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S3.text: And there are the townsfolk who largely live off the tourists who come, not to see the plays, but to look at Anne Hathaway's Cottage, Shakespeare's birthplace and the other sights.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S3.translation: 还有一些镇民主要依靠游客为生，游客来不是为了看戏剧，而是为了参观安妮海瑟薇的小屋、莎士比亚的出生地和其他景点。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S4.text: The worthy residents of Stratford doubt that the theater adds a penny to their revenue.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S4.translation: 斯特拉特福的值得尊敬的居民怀疑剧院是否会给他们增加一分钱的收入。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S5.text: They frankly dislike the RSC's actors, them with their long hair and beards and sandals and noisiness.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S5.translation: 坦率地说，他们不喜欢皇家莎士比亚剧团的演员，他们留着长发、胡须、穿着凉鞋，而且吵闹。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S6.text: It's all deliciously ironic when you consider that Shakespeare, who earns their living, was himself an actor (with a beard) and did his share of noise-making.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P1-S6.translation: 当你想到以谋生为生的莎士比亚本人也是一名演员（留着胡子）并做了他的那份制造噪音的事情时，这一切都是非常讽刺的。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S1.text: The tourist streams are not entirely separate.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S1.translation: 旅游流并不是完全分开的。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S2.text: The sightseers who come by bus—and often take in Warwick Castle and Blenheim Palace on the side—don't usually see the plays, and some of them are even surprised to find a theatre in Stratford.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S2.translation: 乘坐巴士前来的观光客——经常顺便参观沃里克城堡和布莱尼姆宫——通常看不到戏剧，其中一些人甚至惊讶地发现斯特拉特福有一座剧院。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S3.text: However, the playgoers do manage a little sight-seeing along with their playgoing.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S3.translation: 然而，观众们在观看比赛的同时也确实进行了一些观光活动。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S4.text: It is the playgoers, the RSC contends, who bring in much of the town's revenue because they spend the night (some of them four or five nights) pouring cash into the hotels and restaurants.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S4.translation: RSC 认为，正是游客带来了该镇的大部分收入，因为他们在酒店和餐馆过夜（有些是四到五晚），将现金投入其中。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S5.text: The sightseers can take in everything and get out of town by nightfall.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S5.translation: 观光者可以参观一切，并在夜幕降临时离开城镇。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S6.text: The townsfolk don't see it this way and the local council does not contribute directly to the subsidy of the Royal Shakespeare Company.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P2-S6.translation: 镇民并不这么认为，地方议会也不直接为皇家莎士比亚剧团提供补贴。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S1.translation: 斯特拉特福传统上哭穷。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S2.text: Nevertheless every hotel in town seems to be adding a new wing or cocktail lounge.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S2.translation: 尽管如此，城里的每家酒店似乎都在增加一个新的翼楼或鸡尾酒廊。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S3.text: Hilton is building its own hotel there, which you may be sure will be decorated with Hamlet Hamburger Bars, the Lear Lounge, the Banquo Banqueting Room, and so forth, and will be very expensive.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S3.translation: 希尔顿正在那里建造自己的酒店，您可以肯定，酒店将装饰有哈姆雷特汉堡酒吧、李尔酒廊、班柯宴会厅等，而且价格非常昂贵。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S4.text: Anyway, the townsfolk can't understand why the Royal Shakespeare Company needs a subsidy. (The theatre has broken attendance records for three years in a row.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S4.translation: 无论如何，镇民们无法理解为什么皇家莎士比亚剧团需要补贴。 （剧院连续三年打破上座率记录。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S5.text: Last year its 1,431 seats were 94 per cent occupied all year long and this year they'll do better.) The reason, of course, is that costs have rocketed and ticket prices have stayed low.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S5.translation: 去年，它的 1,431 个座位全年都有 94% 的上座率，今年会做得更好。）当然，原因是成本飙升，而票价却保持在较低水平。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S6.text: It would be a shame to raise prices too much because it would drive away the young people who are Stratford's most attractive clientele.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S6.translation: 价格提得太高将是一种耻辱，因为这会赶走斯特拉特福最有吸引力的客户群年轻人。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S7.text: They come entirely for the plays, not the sights.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S7.translation: 他们完全是为了看戏，而不是为了看风景。

ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S8.text: They all seem to look alike (though they come from all over)—lean, pointed, dedicated faces, wearing jeans and sandals, eating their buns and bedding down for the night on the flagstones outside the theatre to buy the 20 seats and 80 standing-room tickets held for the sleepers and sold to them when the box office opens at 10:30 a.m.
ky-en1-2006-r-t2#P3-S8.translation: 他们看起来都很相似（尽管他们来自世界各地）——精瘦、尖尖、专注的面孔，穿着牛仔裤和凉鞋，吃着小圆面包，在剧院外的石板上过夜，购买为卧铺票准备的 20 个座位和 80 个站票，并在上午 10:30 售票处开放时出售给他们。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S1.text: When prehistoric man arrived in new parts of the world, something strange happened to the large animals: they suddenly became extinct.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S1.translation: 当史前人类到达世界新的地方时，大型动物发生了一些奇怪的事情：它们突然灭绝了。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S3.text: The large, slow-growing animals were easy game, and were quickly hunted to extinction.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S3.translation: 这种体型大、生长缓慢的动物很容易被猎杀，但很快就被猎杀至灭绝。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S4.text: Now something similar could be happening in the oceans.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S4.translation: 现在海洋中也可能发生类似的事情。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S5.text: That the seas are being overfished has been known for years.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S5.translation: 多年来，人们都知道海洋正在被过度捕捞。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S6.text: What researchers such as Ransom Myers and Boris Worm have shown is just how fast things are changing.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S6.translation: 兰塞姆·迈尔斯 (Ransom Myers) 和鲍里斯·沃姆 (Boris Worm) 等研究人员已经证明，事情的变化速度有多快。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S7.text: They have looked at half a century of data from fisheries around the world.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P1-S7.translation: 他们研究了半个世纪以来世界各地渔业的数据。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S1.text: Their methods do not attempt to estimate the actual biomass (the amount of living biological matter) of fish species in particular parts of the ocean, but rather changes in that biomass over time.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S1.translation: 他们的方法并不试图估计海洋特定部分鱼类的实际生物量（活生物物质的数量），而是估计该生物量随时间的变化。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S2.text: According to their latest paper published in Nature, the biomass of large predators (animals that kill and eat other animals) in a new fishery is reduced on average by 80% within 15 years of the start of exploitation.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 根据他们在《自然》杂志上发表的最新论文，新渔业中大型捕食者（杀死并吃掉其他动物的动物）的生物量在开始开发后的 15 年内平均减少了 80%。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S3.text: In some long-fished areas, it has halved again since then. Dr. Worm acknowledges that these figures are conservative.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S3.translation: 在一些长期捕捞的地区，此后又减半了。沃姆博士承认这些数字是保守的。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S4.text: One reason for this is that fishing technology has improved.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S4.translation: 造成这种情况的原因之一是捕鱼技术的进步。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S5.text: Today's vessels can find their prey using satellites and sonar, which were not available 50 years ago.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S5.translation: 如今的船只可以利用卫星和声纳来寻找猎物，而这在 50 年前是无法实现的。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S6.text: That means a higher proportion of what is in the sea is being caught, so the real difference between present and past is likely to be worse than the one recorded by changes in catch sizes.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S6.translation: 这意味着海洋中捕获的鱼的比例更高，因此现在和过去之间的真正差异可能比捕获量变化记录的差异更严重。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S7.text: In the early days, too, longlines would have been more saturated with fish.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P2-S7.translation: 在早期，延绳钓中的鱼也更加饱和。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S1.text: Some individuals would therefore not have been caught, since no baited hooks would have been available to trap them, leading to an underestimate of fish stocks in the past.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S1.translation: 因此，有些个体不会被捕获，因为没有诱饵鱼钩来捕获它们，导致过去低估了鱼类种群。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S2.text: Furthermore, in the early days of longline fishing, a lot of fish were lost to sharks after they had been hooked.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S2.translation: 此外，在早期的延绳钓中，很多鱼被鲨鱼上钩后丢失。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S3.text: That is no longer a problem, because there are fewer sharks around now. Dr. Myers and Dr. Worm argue that their work gives a correct baseline, which future management efforts must take into account.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S3.translation: 这不再是问题，因为现在周围的鲨鱼越来越少了。迈尔斯博士和沃姆博士认为，他们的工作提供了正确的基线，未来的管理工作必须考虑到这一点。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S4.text: They believe the data support an idea current among marine biologists, that of the "shifting baseline".
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S4.translation: 他们认为这些数据支持海洋生物学家中流行的一个观点，即“基线移动”。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S5.text: The notion is that people have failed to detect the massive changes which have happened in the ocean because they have been looking back only a relatively short time into the past.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S5.translation: 人们的观点是，人们未能察觉海洋中发生的巨大变化，因为他们只回顾了相对较短的过去。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S6.text: That matters because theory suggests that the maximum sustainable yield that can be cropped from a fishery comes when the biomass of a target species is about 50% of its original levels.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S6.translation: 这很重要，因为理论表明，当目标物种的生物量约为其原始水平的 50% 时，渔业可实现最大可持续产量。

ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S7.text: Most fisheries are well below that, which is a bad way to do business.
ky-en1-2006-r-t3#P3-S7.translation: 大多数渔业的产量远低于这个水平，这是一种糟糕的经营方式。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S1.text: Many things make people think artists are weird.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S1.translation: 很多事情让人们觉得艺术家很奇怪。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S2.text: But the weirdest may be this: artists' only job is to explore emotions, and yet they choose to focus on the ones that feel bad.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S2.translation: 但最奇怪的可能是：艺术家唯一的工作就是探索情感，但他们却选择关注那些感觉不好的东西。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S4.text: The earliest forms of art, like painting and music, are those best suited for expressing joy.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S4.translation: 最早的艺术形式，如绘画和音乐，是最适合表达欢乐的艺术形式。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S5.text: But somewhere from the 19th century onward, more artists began seeing happiness as meaningless, phony or, worst of all, boring, as we went from Wordsworth's daffodils to Baudelaire's flowers of evil.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S5.translation: 但从 19 世纪开始，随着我们从华兹华斯的水仙花转向波德莱尔的邪恶之花，越来越多的艺术家开始认为幸福是毫无意义的、虚假的，或者最糟糕的是，无聊的。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S6.text: You could argue that art became more skeptical of happiness because modern times have seen so much misery.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S6.translation: 你可以说艺术对幸福变得更加怀疑，因为现代已经看到了如此多的痛苦。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S7.text: But it's not as if earlier times didn't know about perpetual war, disaster and the massacre of innocents.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S7.translation: 但这并不是说早期时代不知道无休止的战争、灾难和对无辜者的屠杀。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S8.text: The reason, in fact, may be just the opposite: there is too much damn happiness in the world today.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P1-S8.translation: 事实上，原因可能恰恰相反：当今世界有太多该死的幸福。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S1.text: After all, what is the one modern form of expression almost completely dedicated to depicting happiness?
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S1.translation: 毕竟，一种几乎完全致力于描绘幸福的现代表达形式是什么？

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S3.text: The rise of anti-happy art almost exactly tracks the emergence of mass media, and with it, a commercial culture in which happiness is not just an ideal but an ideology.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S3.translation: 反幸福艺术的兴起几乎完全伴随着大众媒体的出现，以及随之而来的商业文化的出现，在这种文化中，幸福不仅是一种理想，而且是一种意识形态。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S4.text: People in earlier eras were surrounded by reminders of misery.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S4.translation: 早期时代的人们总是被痛苦的回忆所包围。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S5.text: They worked until exhausted, lived with few protections and died young.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S5.translation: 他们工作到筋疲力尽，生活缺乏保护，英年早逝。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S6.text: In the West, before mass communication and literacy, the most powerful mass medium was the church, which reminded worshippers that their souls were in danger and that they would someday be meat for worms.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S6.translation: 在西方，在大众传播和识字之前，最强大的大众媒介是教堂，它提醒信徒，他们的灵魂处于危险之中，有一天他们会成为蠕虫的肉。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S7.text: Given all this, they did not exactly need their art to be a bummer too.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S7.translation: 考虑到这一切，他们并不完全希望自己的艺术也变得无赖。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S8.text: Today the messages the average Westerner is surrounded with are not religious but commercial, and forever happy.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P2-S8.translation: 今天，普通西方人周围的信息不再是宗教性的，而是商业性的，并且永远快乐。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S1.text: Fast-food eaters, news anchors, text messengers, all smiling, smiling, smiling.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S1.translation: 吃快餐的人、新闻主播、短信员，都在微笑、微笑、微笑。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S2.text: Our magazines feature beaming celebrities and happy families in perfect homes.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S2.translation: 我们的杂志以笑容满面的名人和拥有完美住宅的幸福家庭为特色。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S3.text: And since these messages have an agenda—to lure us to open our wallets—they make the very idea of happiness seem unreliable.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S3.translation: 由于这些信息有一个目的——引诱我们打开钱包——它们让幸福的概念看起来不可靠。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S4.text: "Celebrate!" commanded the ads for the arthritis drug Celebrex, before we found out it could increase the risk of heart attacks.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S4.translation: “庆祝！”在我们发现关节炎药物西乐葆会增加心脏病发作的风险之前，他就指挥了它的广告。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S5.text: But what we forget—what our economy depends on us forgetting—is that happiness is more than pleasure without pain.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S5.translation: 但我们忘记了——我们的经济依赖于我们的忘记——幸福不仅仅是没有痛苦的快乐。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S6.text: The things that bring the greatest joy carry the greatest potential for loss and disappointment.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S6.translation: 那些能带来最大快乐的事情也有可能带来最大的损失和失望。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S7.text: Today, surrounded by promises of easy happiness, we need art to tell us, as religion once did, Memento mori: remember that you will die, that everything ends, and that happiness comes not in denying this but in living with it.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S7.translation: 今天，我们被轻松幸福的承诺所包围，我们需要艺术来告诉我们，就像宗教曾经那样，“死亡的象征”：记住你会死，一切都会结束，幸福不是来自于否认这一点，而是来自于与它一起生活。

ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S8.text: It's a message even more bitter than a clove cigarette, yet, somehow, a breath of fresh air.
ky-en1-2006-r-t4#P3-S8.translation: 这是一个比丁香香烟更苦涩的信息，但不知怎的，却是一股新鲜空气。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P1-S1.text: If you were to examine the birth certificates of every soccer player in 2006's World Cup tournament, you would most likely find a noteworthy quirk: elite soccer players are more likely to have been born in the earlier months of the year than in the later months.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P1-S1.translation: 如果你去查看2006年世界杯锦标赛每一位足球运动员的出生证明，很有可能会发现一个耐人寻味的奇特现象：顶尖职业球员出生在上半年的几率要显著高于出生在下半年。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P1-S1.text: If you were to examine the birth certificates of every soccer player in 2006's World Cup tournament, you would most likely find a noteworthy quirk: elite soccer players are more likely to have been born in the earlier months of the year than in the later months.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P1-S1.translation: 如果你去查看2006年世界杯锦标赛每一位足球运动员的出生证明，很有可能会发现一个耐人寻味的奇特现象：顶尖职业球员出生在上半年的几率要显著高于出生在下半年。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P1-S2.text: If you then examined the European national youth teams that feed the World Cup and professional ranks, you would find this strange phenomenon to be even more pronounced.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P1-S2.translation: 如果你再去考察那些向世界杯和职业球队输送人才的欧洲各国青年队，就会发现这一奇怪现象更加明显。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P1-S2.text: If you then examined the European national youth teams that feed the World Cup and professional ranks, you would find this strange phenomenon to be even more pronounced.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P1-S2.translation: 如果你再去考察那些向世界杯和职业球队输送人才的欧洲各国青年队，就会发现这一奇怪现象更加明显。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P2-S1.text: What might account for this strange phenomenon?
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 该如何解释这种奇怪的现象呢？

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P2-S1.text: What might account for this strange phenomenon?
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 该如何解释这种奇怪的现象呢？

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P2-S2.text: Here are a few guesses: a) certain astrological signs confer superior soccer skills; b) winter-born babies tend to have higher oxygen capacity, which increases soccer stamina; c) soccer-mad parents are more likely to conceive children in springtime, at the annual peak of soccer mania; d) none of the above.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P2-S2.translation: 下面是几种猜测：a）某些星座赋予人卓越的足球技能；b）冬天出生的婴儿往往肺活量更高，从而增强了足球耐力；c）酷爱足球的父母更可能在春天怀上孩子，因为春天正是每年足球狂热的巅峰期；d）以上都不是。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P2-S2.translation: 下面是几种猜测：a）某些星座赋予人卓越的足球技能；b）冬天出生的婴儿往往肺活量更高，从而增强了足球耐力；c）酷爱足球的父母更可能在春天怀上孩子，因为春天正是每年足球狂热的巅峰期；d）以上都不是。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S1.text: Anders Ericsson, a 58-year-old psychology professor at Florida State University, says he believes strongly in "none of the above."
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 佛罗里达州立大学58岁的心理学教授安德斯·埃里克森表示，他坚信答案是“以上都不是”。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S1.text: Anders Ericsson, a 58-year-old psychology professor at Florida State University, says he believes strongly in "none of the above."
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 佛罗里达州立大学58岁的心理学教授安德斯·埃里克森表示，他坚信答案是“以上都不是”。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S2.text: Ericsson grew up in Sweden, and studied nuclear engineering until he realized he would have more opportunity to conduct his own research if he switched to psychology.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: 埃里克森在瑞典长大，起初攻读核工程学，直到他意识到如果转向心理学，将有更多机会开展自己独立的研究。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S2.text: Ericsson grew up in Sweden, and studied nuclear engineering until he realized he would have more opportunity to conduct his own research if he switched to psychology.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: 埃里克森在瑞典长大，起初攻读核工程学，直到他意识到如果转向心理学，将有更多机会开展自己独立的研究。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S3.text: His first experiment, nearly 30 years ago, involved memory: training a person to hear and then repeat a random series of numbers.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S3.translation: 将近30年前他所做的第一个实验与记忆力有关：训练一个人在听完一串随机数字后将其复述出来。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S3.text: His first experiment, nearly 30 years ago, involved memory: training a person to hear and then repeat a random series of numbers.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S3.translation: 将近30年前他所做的第一个实验与记忆力有关：训练一个人在听完一串随机数字后将其复述出来。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S4.text: "The first subject, after about 20 hours of training, was able to recall 20 numbers, up from seven," says Ericsson. "He kept improving, and after about 200 hours of training he could recall more than 80 numbers."
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S4.translation: “第一位受试者在经过大约20小时的训练后，能记住的数字从7个提高到了20个，”埃里克森回忆道，“他不断取得突破，在接受了大约200小时的训练后，能记住的数字超过了80个。”

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S4.text: "The first subject, after about 20 hours of training, was able to recall 20 numbers, up from seven," says Ericsson. "He kept improving, and after about 200 hours of training he could recall more than 80 numbers."
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P3-S4.translation: “第一位受试者在经过大约20小时的训练后，能记住的数字从7个提高到了20个，”埃里克森回忆道，“他不断取得突破，在接受了大约200小时的训练后，能记住的数字超过了80个。”

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S1.text: This success, coupled with later research showing that memory itself is not genetically determined, led Ericsson to conclude that the act of memorizing is more of a cognitive exercise than an intuitive one.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S1.translation: 这一成功，加上后来表明记忆本身并非由基因决定的研究所提供的佐证，使埃里克森得出结论：记忆行为更多的是一种认知练习，而不是一种直觉活动。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S1.text: This success, coupled with later research showing that memory itself is not genetically determined, led Ericsson to conclude that the act of memorizing is more of a cognitive exercise than an intuitive one.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S1.translation: 这一成功，加上后来表明记忆本身并非由基因决定的研究所提供的佐证，使埃里克森得出结论：记忆行为更多的是一种认知练习，而不是一种直觉活动。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S2.text: In other words, whatever innate differences two people may exhibit in their abilities to memorize, those differences are swamped by how well each person "encodes" the information.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S2.translation: 换言之，无论两个人在记忆能力方面表现出何种先天差异，这些差异都会被各自对信息进行“编码”的高低水平所掩盖。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S2.text: In other words, whatever innate differences two people may exhibit in their abilities to memorize, those differences are swamped by how well each person "encodes" the information.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S2.translation: 换言之，无论两个人在记忆能力方面表现出何种先天差异，这些差异都会被各自对信息进行“编码”的高低水平所掩盖。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S3.text: And the best way to learn how to encode information meaningfully, Ericsson determined, was a process known as deliberate practice.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S3.translation: 而埃里克森认定，学会对信息进行有意义编码的最佳途径，正是一种被称为“刻意练习”的过程。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S3.text: And the best way to learn how to encode information meaningfully, Ericsson determined, was a process known as deliberate practice.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S3.translation: 而埃里克森认定，学会对信息进行有意义编码的最佳途径，正是一种被称为“刻意练习”的过程。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S4.text: Deliberate practice entails more than simply repeating a task.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S4.translation: 刻意练习绝不仅仅意味着机械重复一项任务。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S4.text: Deliberate practice entails more than simply repeating a task.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S4.translation: 刻意练习绝不仅仅意味着机械重复一项任务。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S5.text: Rather, it involves setting specific goals, obtaining immediate feedback and concentrating as much on technique as on outcome.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S5.translation: 相反，它包括设定具体明确的目标、获取即时反馈，以及在关注技巧的同时同样高度关注结果。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P4-S5.text: Rather, it involves setting specific goals, obtaining immediate feedback and concentrating as much on technique as on outcome.

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S1.text: Ericsson and his colleagues have thus taken to studying expert performers in a wide range of pursuits, including soccer.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S1.translation: 因此，埃里克森和他的同事们开始着手研究各类广泛领域中的顶尖高手，其中就包括足球。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S1.text: Ericsson and his colleagues have thus taken to studying expert performers in a wide range of pursuits, including soccer.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S1.translation: 因此，埃里克森和他的同事们开始着手研究各类广泛领域中的顶尖高手，其中就包括足球。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S2.text: They gather all the data they can, not just performance statistics and biographical details but also the results of their own laboratory experiments with high achievers.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S2.translation: 他们尽可能搜集所有能够获取的数据，不仅包括比赛表现统计和个人传记细节，还包括他们在实验室中对卓越成就者开展的一系列实验结果。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S2.translation: 他们尽可能搜集所有能够获取的数据，不仅包括比赛表现统计和个人传记细节，还包括他们在实验室中对卓越成就者开展的一系列实验结果。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S3.text: Their work makes a rather startling assertion: the trait we commonly call talent is highly overrated.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S3.translation: 他们的研究得出了一个颇为惊人的论断：我们通常所称的“天赋”这一特质被严重高估了。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S3.text: Their work makes a rather startling assertion: the trait we commonly call talent is highly overrated.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S3.translation: 他们的研究得出了一个颇为惊人的论断：我们通常所称的“天赋”这一特质被严重高估了。

ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S4.text: Or, put another way, expert performers—whether in memory or surgery, ballet or computer programming—are nearly always made, not born.
ky-en1-2007-r-t1#P5-S4.translation: 或者换句话说，各领域的顶尖专家——无论是在记忆力还是外科手术、芭蕾舞还是计算机编程领域——几乎无一例外都是后天造就的，而非先天生成的。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S1.text: For the past several years, the Sunday newspaper supplement Parade has featured a column called "Ask Marilyn."
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S1.translation: 在过去的几年里，周日报纸副刊《大观》一直开辟着一个名为“问问玛丽莲”的专栏。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S1.text: For the past several years, the Sunday newspaper supplement Parade has featured a column called "Ask Marilyn."
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S1.translation: 在过去的几年里，周日报纸副刊《大观》一直开辟着一个名为“问问玛丽莲”的专栏。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S2.text: People are invited to query Marilyn Vos Savant, who at age 10 had tested at a mental level of someone about 23 years old; that gave her an IQ of 228—the highest score ever recorded.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S2.translation: 读者被邀请向玛丽莲·沃斯·萨万特提问，她10岁时的智力测试显示其心智水平相当于大约23岁的成年人；这使她获得了228的智商——这是有记录以来的最高得分。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S2.text: People are invited to query Marilyn Vos Savant, who at age 10 had tested at a mental level of someone about 23 years old; that gave her an IQ of 228—the highest score ever recorded.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S2.translation: 读者被邀请向玛丽莲·沃斯·萨万特提问，她10岁时的智力测试显示其心智水平相当于大约23岁的成年人；这使她获得了228的智商——这是有记录以来的最高得分。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S3.text: IQ tests ask you to complete verbal and visual analogies, to envision paper after it has been folded and cut, and to deduce numerical sequences, among other similar tasks.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S3.translation: 智商测试要求受试者完成词语和视觉图形类比，设想纸张折叠和剪切后的形状，并推断数字序列规律，此外还有其他类似任务。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S3.text: IQ tests ask you to complete verbal and visual analogies, to envision paper after it has been folded and cut, and to deduce numerical sequences, among other similar tasks.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S3.translation: 智商测试要求受试者完成词语和视觉图形类比，设想纸张折叠和剪切后的形状，并推断数字序列规律，此外还有其他类似任务。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S4.text: So it is a bit confusing when Vos Savant fields such queries from the average Joe (whose IQ is 100) as, What's the difference between love and fondness? Or what is the nature of luck and coincidence?
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S4.translation: 因此，当沃斯·萨万特应对来自智商为100的普通大众提出的诸如“爱和喜欢有何区别？”或者“运气和巧合的本质是什么？”这类问题时，这着实让人感到有些困惑不解。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S4.translation: 因此，当沃斯·萨万特应对来自智商为100的普通大众提出的诸如“爱和喜欢有何区别？”或者“运气和巧合的本质是什么？”这类问题时，这着实让人感到有些困惑不解。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S5.text: It's not obvious how the capacity to visualize objects and to figure out numerical patterns suits one to answer questions that have eluded some of the best poets and philosophers.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S5.translation: 在脑海中想象物体的能力以及推算数字模式的能力，究竟如何能让一个人具备回答那些连最优秀的诗人和哲学家都无法参透的问题的资格，这一点完全不言自明（实际上令人难以信服）。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S5.text: It's not obvious how the capacity to visualize objects and to figure out numerical patterns suits one to answer questions that have eluded some of the best poets and philosophers.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P1-S5.translation: 在脑海中想象物体的能力以及推算数字模式的能力，究竟如何能让一个人具备回答那些连最优秀的诗人和哲学家都无法参透的问题的资格，这一点完全不言自明（实际上令人难以信服）。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S1.text: Clearly, intelligence encompasses more than a score on a test.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S1.translation: 显而易见，智力所涵盖的内涵远远超出了一次测试所给出的分数。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S1.text: Clearly, intelligence encompasses more than a score on a test.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S1.translation: 显而易见，智力所涵盖的内涵远远超出了一次测试所给出的分数。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S2.text: Just what does it mean to be smart?
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S2.translation: 所谓“聪明”，究竟意味着什么？

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S2.text: Just what does it mean to be smart?
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S2.translation: 所谓“聪明”，究竟意味着什么？

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S3.text: How much of intelligence can be specified, and how much can we learn about it from neurology, genetics, computer science and other fields?
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S3.translation: 智力在多大程度上可以被精确界定？我们又能从神经学、遗传学、计算机科学以及其他学科领域中探知关于智力的多少奥秘？

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S3.text: How much of intelligence can be specified, and how much can we learn about it from neurology, genetics, computer science and other fields?
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P2-S3.translation: 智力在多大程度上可以被精确界定？我们又能从神经学、遗传学、计算机科学以及其他学科领域中探知关于智力的多少奥秘？

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S1.text: The defining term of intelligence in humans still seems to be the IQ score, even though IQ tests are not given as often as they used to be.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S1.translation: 尽管如今智商测试的施测频率已远不如从前，但人类界定智力的核心标志似乎依然是智商分数。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S1.text: The defining term of intelligence in humans still seems to be the IQ score, even though IQ tests are not given as often as they used to be.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S1.translation: 尽管如今智商测试的施测频率已远不如从前，但人类界定智力的核心标志似乎依然是智商分数。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S2.text: The test comes primarily in two forms: the Stanford-Binet Intelligence Scale and the Wechsler Intelligence Scales (both come in adult and children's version).
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S2.translation: 这种测试主要有两种形式：斯坦福-比奈智力量表和韦克斯勒智力量表（两者均有成人版和儿童版）。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S2.translation: 这种测试主要有两种形式：斯坦福-比奈智力量表和韦克斯勒智力量表（两者均有成人版和儿童版）。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S3.text: Generally costing several hundred dollars, they are usually given only by psychologists, although variations of them populate bookstores and the World Wide Web.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S3.translation: 这些正规测试通常花费数百美元，往往仅由专业心理学家主持施测，尽管其各种变体版本已经遍布书店和互联网。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S3.text: Generally costing several hundred dollars, they are usually given only by psychologists, although variations of them populate bookstores and the World Wide Web.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S3.translation: 这些正规测试通常花费数百美元，往往仅由专业心理学家主持施测，尽管其各种变体版本已经遍布书店和互联网。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S4.text: Superhigh scores like Vos Savant's are no longer possible, because scoring is now based on a statistical population distribution among age peers, rather than simply dividing the mental age by the chronological age and multiplying by 100.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S4.translation: 像沃斯·萨万特那样超高的智商分数如今已不可能再出现，因为现在的计分是基于同龄人群体的统计人口正态分布，而不再仅仅是将心理年龄除以实足年龄再乘以100。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S5.text: Other standardized tests, such as the Scholastic Assessment Test (SAT) and the Graduate Record Exam (GRE), capture the main aspects of IQ tests.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S5.translation: 其他标准化测试，例如学术能力评估测试（SAT）和研究生入学资格考试（GRE），也都涵盖了智商测试的主要维度。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S5.text: Other standardized tests, such as the Scholastic Assessment Test (SAT) and the Graduate Record Exam (GRE), capture the main aspects of IQ tests.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P3-S5.translation: 其他标准化测试，例如学术能力评估测试（SAT）和研究生入学资格考试（GRE），也都涵盖了智商测试的主要维度。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S1.text: Such standardized tests may not assess all the important elements necessary to succeed in school and in life, argues Robert J. Sternberg.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S1.translation: 罗伯特·J·斯滕伯格认为，此类标准化考试未必能评估出在学业和人生中取得成功所需的全部关键要素。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S1.text: Such standardized tests may not assess all the important elements necessary to succeed in school and in life, argues Robert J. Sternberg.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S1.translation: 罗伯特·J·斯滕伯格认为，此类标准化考试未必能评估出在学业和人生中取得成功所需的全部关键要素。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S2.text: In his article "How Intelligent Is Intelligence Testing?", Sternberg notes that traditional tests best assess analytical and verbal skills but fail to measure creativity and practical knowledge, components also critical to problem solving and life success.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S2.translation: 斯滕伯格在其发表的文章《智力测试到底有多聪明？》中指出，传统测试最擅长衡量分析和言语技能，却未能测量创造力与实践智慧——而这些要素对于解决现实问题和获取人生成功同样至关重要。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S2.text: In his article "How Intelligent Is Intelligence Testing?", Sternberg notes that traditional tests best assess analytical and verbal skills but fail to measure creativity and practical knowledge, components also critical to problem solving and life success.

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S3.text: Moreover, IQ tests do not necessarily predict so well once populations or situations change.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S3.translation: 此外，一旦受试人群或所处情境发生变化，智商测试的预测效果也未必依然良好。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S3.text: Moreover, IQ tests do not necessarily predict so well once populations or situations change.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S3.translation: 此外，一旦受试人群或所处情境发生变化，智商测试的预测效果也未必依然良好。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S4.text: Research has found that IQ predicted leadership skills when the tests were given under low-stress conditions, but under high-stress conditions, IQ was negatively correlated with leadership—that is, it predicted the opposite.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S4.translation: 研究发现，当测试在低压力环境下进行时，智商能有效预测个体的领导力；但在高压力环境下，智商与领导力却呈负相关——也就是说，它预测出的反而是相反的结果。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S4.text: Research has found that IQ predicted leadership skills when the tests were given under low-stress conditions, but under high-stress conditions, IQ was negatively correlated with leadership—that is, it predicted the opposite.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S4.translation: 研究发现，当测试在低压力环境下进行时，智商能有效预测个体的领导力；但在高压力环境下，智商与领导力却呈负相关——也就是说，它预测出的反而是相反的结果。

ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S5.text: Anyone who has toiled through SAT will testify that test-taking skill also matters, whether it's knowing when to guess or what questions to skip.
ky-en1-2007-r-t2#P4-S5.translation: 任何苦战熬过SAT考试的人都能证明，应试技巧同样起着重要作用——无论是懂得何时该猜测答案，还是该跳过哪些难题。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P1-S1.text: During the past generation, the American middle-class family that once could count on hard work and fair play to keep itself financially secure has been transformed by economic risk and new realities.
ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P1-S1.translation: 在过去的一代人时间里，曾经依靠勤奋工作和公平竞争就能维持自身财务安全的美国中产阶级家庭，如今已被经济风险和新的现实彻底改变。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P1-S2.text: Now a pink slip, a bad diagnosis, or a disappearing spouse can reduce a family from solidly middle class to newly poor in a few months.
ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P1-S2.translation: 如今，一张解雇通知书、一份坏的疾病诊断书、或者一位离家不顾的配偶，就能在短短几个月内让一个稳固的中产家庭沦落为新近致贫的底层。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S1.text: In just one generation, millions of mothers have gone to work, transforming basic family economics.
ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S1.translation: 仅在短短一代人时间里，数以百万计的母亲走上工作岗位，彻底重塑了家庭基本经济结构。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S1.text: In just one generation, millions of mothers have gone to work, transforming basic family economics.

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S2.text: Scholars, policymakers, and critics of all stripes have debated the social implications of these changes, but few have looked at the side effect: family risk has risen as well.
ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 各流派的学者、政策制定者以及批评家们就这些改变的社会影响展开了激烈争论，但极少有人注意到其副作用：家庭承受的风险也随之水涨船高。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S3.text: Today's families have budgeted to the limits of their new two-paycheck status.
ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S3.translation: 如今的家庭已经将开支预算安排到了双薪地位的极限。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S4.text: As a result, they have lost the parachute they once had in times of financial setback—a back-up earner (usually Mom) who could go into the workforce if the primary earner got laid off or fell sick.
ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S4.translation: 其结果是，他们彻底失去了以往在遭遇财务挫折时所拥有的‘降落伞’——即一位后备收入者（通常是母亲），一旦家庭主力挣钱者遭遇下岗或重病，她便能够进入劳动力市场挑起大梁。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S6.text: But today, a disruption to family fortunes can no longer be made up with extra income from an otherwise-stay-at-home partner.
ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P2-S6.translation: 然而在今天，家庭经济财富所遭受的打击，已经无法再通过原本留守在家的配偶外出赚取额外收入来进行弥补。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P3-S1.text: During the same period, families have been asked to absorb much more risk in their retirement income.
ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P3-S1.translation: 在同一时期，家庭还被要求在退休养老收入方面承担多得多的风险。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P3-S2.text: Steelworkers, airline employees, and now those in the auto industry are joining millions of families who must worry about interest rates, stock market fluctuation, and the harsh reality that they may outlive their retirement money.
ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P3-S2.translation: 钢铁工人、航空公司雇员，以及如今汽车产业的从业人员，正纷纷加入数以百万计的家庭行列，他们不得不为利率波动、股市震荡以及‘退休金花光而人尚在世’的残酷现实而忧心忡忡。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P3-S3.text: For much of the past year, President Bush campaigned to move Social Security to a savings-account model, with retirees trading much or all of their guaranteed payments for payments depending on investment returns.
ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P3-S3.translation: 在过去一年的大部分时间里，布什总统大张旗鼓地竞选推动将社会保障金转变为储蓄账户模式，使退休人员用大部分甚至全部有政府保证的固定给付，去换取取决于市场投资回报的款项。

ky-en1-2007-r-t3#P4-S1.text: From the middle-class family perspective, much of this, understandably, looks far less like an opportunity to exercise more financial responsibility, and a good deal more like a frightening acceleration of the wholesale shift of financial risk onto their already overburdened shoulders.

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P1-S2.text: Just as bosses and boards have finally sorted out their worst accounting and compliance troubles, and improved their feeble corporation governance, a new problem threatens to earn them—especially in America—the sort of nasty headlines that inevitably lead to heads rolling in the executive suite: data insecurity.
ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P1-S2.translation: 正当企业老板和董事会好不容易理顺了最棘手的会计和合规麻烦、改善了原本薄弱的公司治理机制之际，一个新的问题却又气势汹汹地威胁要给他们——尤其是在美国——招来那种不可避免会导致高管层引咎辞职的糟糕头条丑闻：这就是数据不安全。

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P1-S2.text: Just as bosses and boards have finally sorted out their worst accounting and compliance troubles, and improved their feeble corporation governance, a new problem threatens to earn them—especially in America—the sort of nasty headlines that inevitably lead to heads rolling in the executive suite: data insecurity.

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P1-S3.text: Left, until now, to odd, low-level IT staff to put right, and seen as a concern only of data-rich industries such as banking, telecoms and air travel, information protection is now high on the boss's agenda in businesses of every variety.
ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P1-S3.translation: 直到最近，信息保护还一直被甩给那些不起眼的底层IT员工去排查修补，并被视为仅仅是银行、电信和民航等数据密集型行业才需要关心的琐事；然而在今天，信息保护却已高高列入各行各业各类企业老板的议事日程之首。

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P2-S1.text: Several massive leakages of customer and employee data this year—from organizations as diverse as Time Warner, the American defense contractor Science Applications International Corp and even the University of California, Berkeley—have left managers hurriedly peering into their intricate IT systems and business processes in search of potential vulnerabilities.
ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P2-S1.translation: 今年爆发的数起大规模客户与员工数据泄露事件——涉及的机构涵盖从时代华纳、美国国防承包商科学应用国际公司，甚至到加利福尼亚大学伯克利分校等形形色色的组织——令管理者们不得不匆忙审视自身错综复杂的IT系统与业务流程，排查潜在的脆弱漏洞。

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P3-S1.text: "Data is becoming an asset which needs to be guarded as much as any other asset," says Haim Mendelson of Stanford University's Graduate School of Business.

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P4-S1.text: The mystery is that this should come as a surprise to any boss.
ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P4-S1.translation: 令人百思不得其解的是，这件事情竟然会让任何一位企业老板感到意外吃惊。

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P4-S1.text: The mystery is that this should come as a surprise to any boss.
ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P4-S1.translation: 令人百思不得其解的是，这件事情竟然会让任何一位企业老板感到意外吃惊。

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P4-S2.text: Surely it should be obvious to the dimmest executive that trust, that most valuable of economic assets, is easily destroyed and hugely expensive to restore—and that few things are more likely to destroy trust than a company letting sensitive personal data get into the wrong hands.
ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P4-S2.translation: 显而易见，即便是最愚钝的企业高管也理当心知肚明：信任，作为最具经济价值的核心资产，极易遭到摧毁，而恢复起来却代价连城——而且，没有什么比一家公司任由敏感个人数据落入不法之徒手中更容易摧毁这种信任的了。

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P5-S1.text: The current state of affairs may have been encouraged—though not justified—by the lack of legal penalty (in America, but not Europe) for data leakage.
ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P5-S1.translation: 数据泄露在美国（而非欧洲）缺乏法律惩戒机制，这一现状或许助长了当前的恶劣事态——尽管这并不能成为企业推卸责任的正当借口。

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P5-S2.text: Until California recently passed a law, American firms did not have to tell anyone, even the victim, when data went astray.
ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P5-S2.translation: 在加利福尼亚州最近通过一项法律之前，美国企业在数据发生遗失外泄时，甚至根本无需通知任何人，连受害客户本人也不例外。

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P5-S3.text: That may change fast: lots of proposed data-security legislation is now doing the rounds in Washington, D.C.
ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P5-S3.translation: 这种局面可能会迅速发生改变：大量拟议中的数据安全立法目前正在华盛顿特区国会山紧锣密鼓地展开审议游说。

ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P5-S4.text: Meanwhile, the theft of information about some 40 million credit-card accounts in America, disclosed on June 17th, overshadowed a hugely important decision a day earlier by America's Federal Trade Commission (FTC) that puts corporate America on notice that regulators will act if firms fail to provide adequate data security.
ky-en1-2007-r-t4#P5-S4.translation: 与此同时，6月17日披露的高达4000万个美国信用卡账户信息失窃丑闻，使得前一天美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）做出的一项极其重要的决定相形见绌——该决定正式向全美企业发出严厉通告：一旦公司未能提供充分的数据安全保障，监管机构将铁腕采取惩罚行动。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P1-S1.text: While still catching up to men in some spheres of modern life, women appear to be way ahead in at least one undesirable category.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P1-S1.translation: 尽管在现代生活的某些领域中女性仍在奋力追赶男性，但至少在一个并不令人羡慕的方面，她们似乎已经遥遥领先。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P1-S1.text: While still catching up to men in some spheres of modern life, women appear to be way ahead in at least one undesirable category.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P1-S1.translation: 尽管在现代生活的某些领域中女性仍在奋力追赶男性，但至少在一个并不令人羡慕的方面，她们似乎已经遥遥领先。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P1-S2.text: "Women are particularly susceptible to developing depression and anxiety disorders in response to stress compared to men," according to Dr. Yehuda, chief psychiatrist at New York's Veteran's Administration Hospital.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P1-S2.translation: 纽约退伍军人管理医院的首席精神科医师耶胡达博士指出：“与男性相比，女性在面对压力时尤其容易患上抑郁和焦虑障碍。”

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P1-S2.text: "Women are particularly susceptible to developing depression and anxiety disorders in response to stress compared to men," according to Dr. Yehuda, chief psychiatrist at New York's Veteran's Administration Hospital.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P1-S2.translation: 纽约退伍军人管理医院的首席精神科医师耶胡达博士指出：“与男性相比，女性在面对压力时尤其容易患上抑郁和焦虑障碍。”

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P2-S1.text: Studies of both animals and humans have shown that sex hormones somehow affect the stress response, causing females under stress to produce more of the trigger chemicals than do males under the same conditions.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 针对动物和人类的研究均表明，性激素会以某种方式影响压力反应，使得处于压力之下的雌性分泌出比同等条件下的雄性更多的诱发性化学物质。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P2-S1.text: Studies of both animals and humans have shown that sex hormones somehow affect the stress response, causing females under stress to produce more of the trigger chemicals than do males under the same conditions.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 针对动物和人类的研究均表明，性激素会以某种方式影响压力反应，使得处于压力之下的雌性分泌出比同等条件下的雄性更多的诱发性化学物质。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P2-S2.text: In several of the studies, when stressed-out female rats had their ovaries (the female reproductive organs) removed, their chemical responses became equal to those of the males.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P2-S2.translation: 在其中的几项研究中，当承受高压的母鼠被摘除卵巢（雌性生殖器官）后，它们的化学反应就变得与公鼠旗鼓相当。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P2-S2.text: In several of the studies, when stressed-out female rats had their ovaries (the female reproductive organs) removed, their chemical responses became equal to those of the males.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P2-S2.translation: 在其中的几项研究中，当承受高压的母鼠被摘除卵巢（雌性生殖器官）后，它们的化学反应就变得与公鼠旗鼓相当。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S1.text: Adding to a woman's increased dose of stress chemicals, are her increased "opportunities" for stress.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 除了女性体内压力化学物质分泌增加之外，她们遭遇压力的“机会”也大大增多（雪上加霜）。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S1.text: Adding to a woman's increased dose of stress chemicals, are her increased "opportunities" for stress.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 除了女性体内压力化学物质分泌增加之外，她们遭遇压力的“机会”也大大增多（雪上加霜）。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S2.text: "It's not necessarily that women don't cope as well.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: “这倒未必是因为女性自身的应对能力更差。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S2.text: "It's not necessarily that women don't cope as well.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: “这倒未必是因为女性自身的应对能力更差。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S3.text: It's just that they have so much more to cope with," says Dr. Yehuda.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S3.translation: 只是因为她们需要应付的事情实在要多得多，”耶胡达博士说。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S3.text: It's just that they have so much more to cope with," says Dr. Yehuda.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S3.translation: 只是因为她们需要应付的事情实在要多得多，”耶胡达博士说。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S4.text: "Their capacity for tolerating stress may even be greater than men's," she observes, "it's just that they're dealing with so many more things that they become worn out from it more visibly and sooner."
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S4.translation: 她观察指出：“她们承受压力的耐受力甚至可能比男性更强；只是她们需要处理的事情如此之多，以至于她们因压力而精疲力竭的表现显得更为明显、也来得更早。”

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P3-S4.text: "Their capacity for tolerating stress may even be greater than men's," she observes, "it's just that they're dealing with so many more things that they become worn out from it more visibly and sooner."

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S1.text: Dr. Yehuda notes another difference between the sexes.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S1.translation: 耶胡达博士还指出了两性之间的另一处显著差别。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S1.text: Dr. Yehuda notes another difference between the sexes.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S1.translation: 耶胡达博士还指出了两性之间的另一处显著差别。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S2.text: "I think that the kinds of things that women are exposed to tend to be in more of a chronic or repeated nature.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S2.translation: “我认为，女性所面临的那些生活事件，往往更具有长期性或反复性的特质。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S3.text: Men go to war and are exposed to combat stress.
ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S3.translation: 男性奔赴战场，承受战斗带来的创伤压力。

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S4.text: Men are exposed to more acts of random physical violence.

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S4.text: Men are exposed to more acts of random physical violence.

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P4-S5.text: The kinds of interpersonal violence that women are exposed to tend to be in domestic situations, by, unfortunately, parents or other family members, and they tend not to be one-shot deals.

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P6-S2.text: But most women today are coping with a lot of obligations, with few breaks, and feeling the strain.

ky-en1-2008-r-t1#P6-S3.text: Alvarez's experience demonstrates the importance of finding ways to diffuse stress before it threatens your health and your ability to function.

ky-en1-2008-r-t2#P2-S2.text: The Internet—and pressure from funding agencies, who are questioning why commercial publishers are making money from government-funded research by restricting access to it—is making access to scientific results a reality.

ky-en1-2008-r-t2#P4-S4.text: There is the so-called big deal, where institutional subscribers pay for access to a collection of online journal titles through site-licensing agreements.

ky-en1-2008-r-t3#P3-S3.translation: 但随着饮食营养与医疗卫生状况的显著改善，儿童和青少年平均每20年身高就增长约1.5英寸，这种模式在人类学上被称为‘身高长期趋势’。

ky-en1-2008-r-t3#P3-S4.text: Yet according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, average height—5' 9" for men, 5' 4" for women—hasn't really changed since 1960.

ky-en1-2008-r-t3#P4-S3.text: Moreover, even though humans have been upright for millions of years, our feet and back continue to struggle with bipedal posture and cannot easily withstand repeated strain imposed by oversize limbs.

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P1-S2.text: We reach for them mindlessly, setting our brains on auto-pilot and relaxing into the unconscious comfort of familiar routine.
ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P1-S2.translation: 我们不假思索地依赖习惯，让大脑进入‘自动驾驶’状态，安然享受熟悉常规所带来的那种潜意识的舒适。

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P1-S2.text: We reach for them mindlessly, setting our brains on auto-pilot and relaxing into the unconscious comfort of familiar routine.

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P1-S3.text: "Not choice, but habit rules the unreflecting herd," William Wordsworth said in the 19th century.
ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P1-S3.translation: 19世纪英国浪漫主义诗人威廉·华兹华斯曾说过：“支配着那些缺乏反思的大众的，不是理性抉择，而是盲目习惯。”

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P1-S4.text: In the ever-changing 21st century, even the word "habit" carries a negative implication.
ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P1-S4.translation: 而在瞬息万变的21世纪，甚至连“习惯”这个词本身都带有一层消极负面的暗示意味。

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P1-S4.text: In the ever-changing 21st century, even the word "habit" carries a negative implication.

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P2-S1.text: So it seems paradoxical to talk about habits in the same context as creativity and innovation.
ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 因此，若把习惯与创造力和创新放在同一个语境下一同讨论，似乎显得自相矛盾。

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P2-S1.text: So it seems paradoxical to talk about habits in the same context as creativity and innovation.
ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 因此，若把习惯与创造力和创新放在同一个语境下一同讨论，似乎显得自相矛盾。

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P2-S2.text: But brain researchers have discovered that when we consciously develop new habits, we create parallel paths, and even entirely new brain cells, that can jump our trains of thought onto new, innovative tracks.
ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P2-S2.translation: 然而脑科学研究人员发现，当我们有意识地培养新习惯时，我们会在大脑中开辟出一条条平行的通路，甚至生成全新的脑细胞，这能把我们的思路跃迁引入崭新的、富有创新性的轨道。

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P3-S1.text: Rather than dismissing ourselves as unchangeable creatures of habit, we can instead direct our own change by consciously developing new habits.
ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 与其把自己轻易贬低为不可改变的“习惯的奴隶”，我们反而可以通过有意识地培养新习惯，来亲自引导我们自身的改变。

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P3-S1.text: Rather than dismissing ourselves as unchangeable creatures of habit, we can instead direct our own change by consciously developing new habits.

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P3-S2.text: In fact, the more new things we try—the more we step outside our comfort zone—the more inherently creative we become, both in the workplace and in our personal lives.
ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: 事实上，我们尝试的新事物越多——越是勇敢迈出自身的舒适区——我们在职场工作与个人生活中就会变得越发富有与生俱来的创造力。

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P3-S2.text: In fact, the more new things we try—the more we step outside our comfort zone—the more inherently creative we become, both in the workplace and in our personal lives.

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P4-S1.text: But don't bother trying to kill off old habits; once those ruts of procedure are worn into the brain, they're there to stay.
ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P4-S1.translation: 但切莫费心去试图彻底消灭旧习惯；一旦那些按部就班的程序化车辙痕迹磨损刻入大脑，它们就会永久留存、难以磨灭。

ky-en1-2009-r-t1#P5-S3.text: She adds, however, that "to decide is to kill off all possibilities but one."

ky-en1-2009-r-t2#P5-S3.text: He notes that each individual has many ancestors—numbering in the hundreds just a few centuries back.

ky-en1-2009-r-t2#P5-S4.text: Yet most ancestry testing only considers a single lineage, either the Y chromosome inherited through men in a father's line or mitochondrial DNA, which is passed down only from mothers.

ky-en1-2009-r-t3#P1-S1.text: The relationship between formal education and economic growth in poor countries is widely misunderstood by economists and politicians alike.

ky-en1-2009-r-t3#P1-S1.text: The relationship between formal education and economic growth in poor countries is widely misunderstood by economists and politicians alike.

ky-en1-2009-r-t3#P1-S2.text: Progress in both areas is undoubtedly necessary for the social, political and intellectual development of these and all other societies; however, the conventional view that education should be one of the very highest priorities for promoting rapid economic development in poor countries is wrong.
ky-en1-2009-r-t3#P1-S2.translation: 毫无疑问，这两个领域的共同进步对于这些贫困国家乃至所有其他社会的社会、政治与思想发展都是必不可少的；然而，认为教育应当是贫困国家促进经济快速发展的最高优先级之一的传统观点，是完全错误的。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P1-S1.text: The most thoroughly studied intellectuals in the history of the New World are the ministers and political leaders of seventeenth-century New England.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P1-S1.translation: 在美洲新大陆的历史上，被研究得最为详尽透彻的知识分子群体，是17世纪新英格兰的牧师和政治领袖们。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P1-S1.text: The most thoroughly studied intellectuals in the history of the New World are the ministers and political leaders of seventeenth-century New England.

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P1-S2.text: According to the standard history of American philosophy, nowhere else in colonial America was "so much importance attached to intellectual pursuits."
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P1-S2.translation: 按照权威公认的美国哲学史著作的记述，在整个殖民地时期的美洲，没有任何地方像这里一样“对求知探索与学术追求给予了如此高度的重视”。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P1-S3.text: According to many books and articles, New England's leaders established the basic themes and preoccupations of an unfolding, dominant Puritan tradition in American intellectual life.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P1-S3.translation: 根据浩繁的学术书籍和论文的记载，新英格兰的早期领袖确立了美国思想生活中一个不断延展、居于主导地位的清教传统的基本主题与核心关切。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P2-S1.text: To take this approach to the New Englanders normally means to start with the Puritans' theological innovations and their distinctive ideas about the church—important subjects that we may not neglect.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P2-S1.translation: 采用这种研究路径来考察新英格兰人，通常意味着要从清教徒的神学教义创新以及他们对教会治理的独特见解切入——这些确实是我们不容忽视的重要课题。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P2-S2.text: But in keeping with our examination of southern intellectual life, we may consider the original Puritans as carriers of European culture, adjusting to New World circumstances.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P2-S2.translation: 但是，为了与我们对北美南部思想生活的考察脉络保持一致，我们不妨将最初的这批清教徒视作欧洲旧大陆文化的承载者与播种者，正在逐步适应美洲新大陆的全新环境。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P2-S3.text: The New England colonies were the scenes of important episodes in the pursuit of widely understood ideals of civility and virtuosity.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P2-S3.translation: 新英格兰殖民地正是追求在当时被广泛认同的文明修养与崇高德行理想这一壮阔历程中一系列重要历史事件的发生舞台。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P3-S1.text: The early settlers of Massachusetts Bay included men of impressive education and influence in England.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P3-S1.translation: 马萨诸塞湾的早期定居者当中，包括了一批在英格兰本土就已受过极高水准教育、具有广泛社会声望与影响力的精英人物。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P3-S1.text: The early settlers of Massachusetts Bay included men of impressive education and influence in England.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P3-S1.translation: 马萨诸塞湾的早期定居者当中，包括了一批在英格兰本土就已受过极高水准教育、具有广泛社会声望与影响力的精英人物。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P3-S2.text: Besides the ninety or so learned ministers who came to Massachusetts churches in the decade after 1629, there were political leaders like John Winthrop, an educated gentleman, lawyer, and official of the Crown before he journeyed to Boston.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P3-S2.translation: 除1629年之后十年间来到马萨诸塞各教会任职的约90位博学多才的牧师之外，这里还有像约翰·温思罗普这样的政治领袖——在启程前往波士顿之前，他就是一位受过良好教育的绅士、出庭律师和英格兰王室官员。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P3-S3.text: These men wrote and published extensively, reaching both New World and Old World audiences, and giving New England an atmosphere of intellectual earnestness.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P3-S3.translation: 这批领袖广泛著书立说并大量出版，其读者群横跨大西洋两岸的新旧大陆，从而为新英格兰注入了一种严肃庄重、探求真理的思想求索氛围。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S1.text: We should not forget, however, that most New Englanders were less well educated.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S1.translation: 然而，我们绝不应当忘记的是，绝大多数普通新英格兰人所受的教育程度其实要低得多。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S1.text: We should not forget, however, that most New Englanders were less well educated.

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S2.text: While few craftsmen or farmers, let alone dependents and servants, left literary compositions to be analyzed, it is obvious that their views were less fully intellectualized.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S2.translation: 虽然极少有手工业工匠或自耕农——更不用说家眷仆役了——留下了可供后人分析考证的书面文学作品，但显而易见的是，他们的思想观念并没有那么高度的思辨理性化。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S3.text: Their thinking often had a traditional superstitious quality.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S3.translation: 他们的日常思维方式往往带有极其浓厚的传统民间迷信色彩。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S4.text: A tailor named John Dane, who emigrated in the late 1630s, left an account of his reasons for leaving England that is filled with signs.
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S4.translation: 一位在17世纪30年代末移民美洲、名叫约翰·丹恩的裁缝，留下了一份记述自己离开英格兰原因的回忆录，通篇充斥着各种超自然的神秘兆头与预言征兆。

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S5.text: Sexual confusion, economic frustrations, and religious hope—all came together in a decisive moment when he opened the Bible, told his father that the first line he saw would settle his fate, and read the magical words: "Come out from among them, touch no unclean thing, and I will be your God and you shall be my people."
ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P4-S5.translation: 性心理的困惑迷茫、经济上的屡屡受挫以及宗教信仰的狂热希望——所有这些情绪在一个决定性时刻交织汇聚在一起：他猛然翻开《圣经》，对父亲宣称自己看到的第一行经文将决定自己的终身命运，随即读出了那句具有神秘魔力的箴言：“务要从他们中间出来，不可沾不洁净之物，我就作你们的神，你们要作我的子民。”

ky-en1-2009-r-t4#P5-S1.text: Meanwhile, many settlers had slighter religious commitments than Dane's, as one clergyman learned in confronting folk along the coast who mocked that they had not come to the New World for religion.

ky-en1-2010-r-t1#P1-S1.text: Of all the changes that have taken place in English-language newspapers during the past quarter-century, perhaps the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline in the scope and seriousness of their arts coverage.
ky-en1-2010-r-t1#P1-S1.translation: 在过去四分之一世纪里英语报纸所发生的全部变迁之中，影响最为深远的或许莫过于其艺术报道在报道范围与思想严肃性上不可阻挡的急剧衰退。

ky-en1-2010-r-t1#P2-S1.text: It is difficult to the point of impossibility for the average reader under the age of forty to imagine a time when high-quality arts criticism could be found in most big-city newspapers.

ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P1-S1.text: In his book The Tipping Point, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics" are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials, who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well-connected.
ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P1-S1.translation: 马尔科姆·格拉德威尔在其著作《引爆点》中提出，“社会流行风潮”在很大程度上是由极少数特殊个体（通常被称为‘意见领袖/关键人物’）的行为推动的，这些人往往格外博学多才、极具说服力或人脉四通八达。

ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P1-S2.text: The tipping point is that magic moment when an idea, trend, or social behavior crosses a threshold, tips, and spreads like wildfire.
ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P1-S2.translation: 所谓引爆点，就是观念、风尚或社会行为跨越临界阈值、发生质变翻转并如野火般迅速蔓延的那一神奇时刻。

ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P3-S1.text: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that the influentials' impact is not as significant as previously thought.
ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P3-S1.translation: 然而，一些研究人员在最近的研究中得出了一个令人诧异的新结论：意见领袖的实际影响力远没有人们此前所认为的那样显著重要。

ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P3-S1.text: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that the influentials' impact is not as significant as previously thought.

ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P4-S1.text: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: with the exception of a few celebrities, who have vast media exposure, most people are influenced by their peers.
ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P4-S1.translation: 研究人员的论点源于对社会影响力机制的一个简单观察：除了少数拥有海量媒体曝光度的极少数名流之外，绝大多数普通人主要受到自身同伴圈层（peers）的影响。

ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P4-S2.text: Building on this observation, Duncan Watts, a sociologist at Columbia University, built a series of computer simulations of social epidemics.
ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P4-S2.translation: 基于这一观察，哥伦比亚大学社会学家邓肯·沃茨建立了一系列针对社会流行风潮的计算机模型模拟仿真。

ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P4-S3.text: In his models, he found that social epidemics cascade through a network only when a critical mass of easily influenced individuals are present.
ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P4-S3.translation: 在他的模型中，他发现只有当网络中存在达到关键临界规模的一批‘极易受影响的个体’时，社会流行风潮才会像瀑布般级联式蔓延开来。

ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P4-S4.text: These people are influenced by the initial message, and then in turn influence others, creating a cascade.
ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P4-S4.translation: 这批人先是受到最初信息的感召与影响，随后又反过来转而影响身边的其他人，从而催生出一场连锁式的级联反应。

ky-en1-2010-r-t3#P5-S1.text: A critical mass of susceptible people, not the presence of influentials, is the crucial factor.

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 然而，这次任命之所以如此令人感到意外，原因之一正在于吉尔伯特的公众知名度相对较低。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P2-S2.text: Even Tommasini, who had advocated Gilbert's appointment in the Times, calls him "an unpretentious musician with no air of the formidable conductor about him."
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P2-S2.translation: 就连曾在《纽约时报》撰文力挺吉尔伯特任命的托马西尼，也称他为“一位谦逊低调的音乐家，身上毫无那种令人敬畏的大指挥家的傲慢架子”。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P2-S2.text: Even Tommasini, who had advocated Gilbert's appointment in the Times, calls him "an unpretentious musician with no air of the formidable conductor about him."

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P2-S3.text: As a description of the next music director of an orchestra that has hitherto been led by musicians like Gustav Mahler and Pierre Boulez, that seems likely to have struck at least some Times readers as faint praise.
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P2-S3.translation: 对于一支迄今为止一直由古斯塔夫·马勒和皮埃尔·布列兹等泰斗级大师执掌的乐团的下一任掌门人而言，这样的描述在至少一部分《纽约时报》读者看来，恐怕更像是一种明褒实贬的勉强恭维。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P3-S1.text: For my part, I have no idea whether Gilbert is a great conductor or even a good one.
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 就我个人而言，我并不清楚吉尔伯特到底是不是一位伟大的指挥家，甚至不知道他算不算得上一位优秀指挥。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P3-S2.text: To be sure, he performs an impressive variety of interesting compositions, but it is not necessary for me to visit Avery Fisher Hall, or anywhere else, to hear interesting orchestral music.
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: 诚然，他所执棒演奏的曲目确实种类繁多且引人入胜，但我若想聆听有趣的管弦乐，却完全没有必要专程前往艾弗里·费舍尔音乐厅或任何其他实体场所。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P4-S1.text: Devoted concertgoers who reply that recordings are no substitute for live performance are missing the point.
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P4-S1.translation: 那些回应声称‘录音永远无法替代现场演出’的忠实音乐会常客，实际上完全没有抓住问题的核心实质。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P4-S2.text: For the time, attention, and money of the art-loving public, classical instrumentalists must compete not only with opera houses, dance troupes, theater companies, and museums, but also with the recorded performances of the great classical musicians of the 20th century.
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P4-S2.translation: 为了争夺热爱艺术的大众有限的时间、注意力和金钱，当今的古典器乐演奏家不仅要与歌剧院、舞蹈团、话剧社和博物馆竞争，还必须同20世纪那些最伟大的传奇古典音乐大师们留下的不朽录音同台竞逐。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P4-S2.text: For the time, attention, and money of the art-loving public, classical instrumentalists must compete not only with opera houses, dance troupes, theater companies, and museums, but also with the recorded performances of the great classical musicians of the 20th century.
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P4-S2.translation: 为了争夺热爱艺术的大众有限的时间、注意力和金钱，当今的古典器乐演奏家不仅要与歌剧院、舞蹈团、话剧社和博物馆竞争，还必须同20世纪那些最伟大的传奇古典音乐大师们留下的不朽录音同台竞逐。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P4-S3.text: These recordings are cheap, available everywhere, and very often much higher in artistic quality than today's live performances; moreover, they can be "consumed" at a time and place of the listener's choosing.
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P4-S3.translation: 这些唱片录音价格极其低廉、随处可买可听，而且在艺术水准上往往远比当今的现场演出高得多；此外，听众还完全可以在自己选择的时间和地点随心享用消费。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P4-S4.text: The widespread availability of such recordings has thus brought about a crisis in the institution of the traditional classical concert.
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P4-S4.translation: 因此，此类优质录音的唾手可得与广泛普及，给传统古典现场音乐会这一体制带来了毁灭性的生存危机。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P5-S1.text: One possible response is for classical performers to program attractive new music that is not yet available on record.
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P5-S1.translation: 一种可能的应对方案，是让古典演奏家们在节目单中安排排演那些尚未被录制成唱片的、极具吸引力的新作品。

ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P5-S2.text: Gilbert's own interest in new music has been widely noted: Alex Ross, a classical-music critic, has described him as a man who is capable of turning the Philharmonic into "a markedly different, more vibrant organization."
ky-en1-2011-r-t1#P5-S2.translation: 吉尔伯特本人对新音乐的浓厚兴趣已受到广泛关注：古典乐评人亚历克斯·罗斯就曾将他描绘为一个有能力将纽约爱乐乐团打造成“一个截然不同、更富生机活力的团体”的关键人物。

ky-en1-2011-r-t2#P1-S1.text: When Liam McGee departed as president of Bank of America in August, his explanation was surprisingly straight up.

ky-en1-2011-r-t2#P1-S1.text: When Liam McGee departed as president of Bank of America in August, his explanation was surprisingly straight up.
ky-en1-2011-r-t2#P1-S1.translation: 利亚姆·麦基今年八月卸任美国银行总裁时，他给出的解释直白得出人意料。

ky-en1-2011-r-t2#P1-S2.text: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving "to pursue my goal of running a company."
ky-en1-2011-r-t2#P1-S2.translation: 他没有用惯常那种含糊的托词来掩饰自己的离去，而是直言不讳地表示，他离职是“为了实现自己经营一家公司的目标”。

ky-en1-2011-r-t3#P1-S4.text: Consumers passionate about a product may create "earned" media by willingly promoting it to friends, and a company may leverage "owned" media by sending e-mail alerts about products and sales to customers registered with its Web site.
ky-en1-2011-r-t3#P1-S4.translation: 热衷于某种产品的消费者可能会主动向朋友推荐，从而形成“赢得（口碑）”媒体；企业也可以借助“自有”媒体，通过电子邮件向已在其网站注册的顾客发送产品和促销信息。

ky-en1-2011-r-t3#P2-S1.text: Paid and owned media are controlled by marketers promoting their own products.

ky-en1-2011-r-t3#P2-S3.text: But in some cases, one marketer's owned media become another marketer's paid media, for instance, when an e-commerce retailer sells ad space on its Web site.

ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P1-S2.translation: 西尼尔并没有断言孩子会让父母或幸福或痛苦，而是提出我们需要重新定义幸福：与其把幸福看作可以用当下时刻的快乐来衡量的东西，不如把幸福理解为一种回望过去时才呈现的状态。

ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P1-S3.text: Even though the day-to-day experience of raising kids can be soul-crushingly hard, Senior writes that "the very things that in the moment dampen our moods can later be sources of intense gratification and delight."
ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P1-S3.translation: 即使养育孩子的日常经历可能令人心力交瘁，西尼尔写道，“那些当时让我们情绪低落的事情，日后却可能成为强烈满足感和快乐的源泉。”

ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P3-S3.text: Unhappy parents rarely are provoked to wonder if they shouldn't have had kids, but unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world: obviously their misery must be a direct result of the gaping baby-size holes in their lives.
ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P3-S3.translation: 不幸福的父母很少会被促使去反思自己当初是不是不该要孩子；而不幸福的无子女者却不断被这样一种信息所困扰：孩子是这世上头等重要的东西——显然，他们的不幸一定源于生活中孩子的空缺。

ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P4-S1.translation: 当然，《美国周刊》和《人物》这类名人杂志所呈现的父母形象极不现实，尤其是当父母是像布洛克这样的单身母亲时。

ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P4-S3.text: No shock there, considering how much work it is to raise a kid without a partner to lean on; yet to hear Sandra and Britney tell it, raising a kid on their "own" (read: with round-the-clock help) is a piece of cake.
ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P4-S3.translation: 考虑到在没有伴侣依靠的情况下抚养孩子有多辛苦，这结论并不令人震惊；然而，听桑德拉和布兰妮说起来，她们“独自”（其实有全天候帮手）抚养孩子是小菜一碟。

ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P5-S1.text: It's hard to imagine that many people are dumb enough to want children just because Reese and Angelina make it look so glamorous: most adults understand that a baby is not a haircut.
ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P5-S1.translation: 很难想象会有很多人轻率到只因为瑞茜和安吉丽娜把生孩子这件事演绎得如此光鲜就想要孩子：大多数成年人都明白，养孩子可不是像做个发型（那么简单）。

ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P5-S2.text: But it's interesting to wonder if the images we see every week of stress-free, happiness-enhancing parenthood aren't in some small, subconscious way contributing to our own dissatisfactions with the actual experience, in the same way that a small part of us hoped getting "the Rachel" might make us look just a little bit like Jennifer Aniston.
ky-en1-2011-r-t4#P5-S2.translation: 但值得玩味的是，我们每周所看到的那些无忧无虑、让人倍感幸福的育儿画面，是否在某种细微的、下意识的层面上助长了我们对真实育儿体验的不满——就像我们内心深处也曾隐隐指望，剪一个“瑞秋发型”能让自己看起来多多少少有点像珍妮弗·安尼斯顿（《老友记》瑞秋的扮演者）。

ky-en1-2012-r-t1#P1-S4.text: But in her new book Join The Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.
ky-en1-2012-r-t1#P1-S4.translation: 但蒂娜·罗森伯格在新书《加入俱乐部》中主张，通过她所说的“社会疗法”，同辈压力也可以成为一种积极力量；在这种疗法中，组织和官员借助群体动力，帮助个人改善生活，甚至有可能改善世界。

ky-en1-2012-r-t1#P2-S1.text: Rosenberg, the recipient of a Pulitzer Prize, offers a host of examples of the social cure in action: In South Carolina, a state-sponsored antismoking program called Rage Against the Haze sets out to make cigarettes uncool.
ky-en1-2012-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 罗森伯格曾获普利策奖，她列举了大量社会疗法付诸实践的例子：在南卡罗来纳州，一项由州政府发起、名为“对抗烟雾”的禁烟项目，力图让吸烟变得不再“酷”。

ky-en1-2012-r-t1#P3-S1.text: The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer.

ky-en1-2012-r-t1#P3-S2.text: Her critique of the lameness of many public-health campaigns is spot-on: they fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits, and they demonstrate a seriously flawed understanding of psychology.
ky-en1-2012-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: 她对许多公共卫生宣传活动效果不佳的批评十分准确：这些活动未能利用同辈压力来促进健康习惯，而且显示出其对心理学的理解存在严重缺陷。
