ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S2.text: Similar to newly staked mining claims, they are full of potential.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 它们就像新登记的采矿权一样，充满潜力。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S2.text: Similar to newly staked mining claims, they are full of potential.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 它们就像新登记的采矿权一样，充满潜力。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S3.text: But it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S3.translation: 但要把一项发现主张变成一项成熟的发现，还需要集体的审视与接受。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S3.text: But it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S3.translation: 但要把一项发现主张变成一项成熟的发现，还需要集体的审视与接受。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S4.text: This is the credibility process, through which the individual researcher's me, here, now becomes the community's anyone, anywhere, anytime.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S4.translation: 这就是可信度形成的过程，通过它，研究者个人的“此时此地的我”变成了共同体的“任何人、任何地方、任何时候”。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S4.text: This is the credibility process, through which the individual researcher's me, here, now becomes the community's anyone, anywhere, anytime.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S4.translation: 这就是可信度形成的过程，通过它，研究者个人的“此时此地的我”变成了共同体的“任何人、任何地方、任何时候”。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S5.text: Objective knowledge is the goal, not the starting point.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S5.translation: 客观知识是目标，而不是起点。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S5.text: Objective knowledge is the goal, not the starting point.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P2-S5.translation: 客观知识是目标，而不是起点。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S1.text: Once a discovery claim becomes public, the discoverer receives intellectual credit.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S1.translation: 一旦某项发现主张公之于众，发现者便获得学术上的认可。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S1.text: Once a discovery claim becomes public, the discoverer receives intellectual credit.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S1.translation: 一旦某项发现主张公之于众，发现者便获得学术上的认可。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S2.text: But, unlike with mining claims, the community takes control of what happens next.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S2.translation: 但与采矿权不同的是，接下来发生什么由共同体掌控。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S2.text: But, unlike with mining claims, the community takes control of what happens next.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S2.translation: 但与采矿权不同的是，接下来发生什么由共同体掌控。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S3.text: Within the complex social structure of the scientific community, researchers make discoveries; editors and reviewers act as gatekeepers by controlling the publication process; other scientists use the new finding to suit their own purposes; and finally, the public (including other scientists) receives the new discovery and possibly accompanying technology.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S3.translation: 在科学共同体这一复杂的社会结构中，研究者作出发现；编辑和审稿人通过掌控发表过程充当把关人；其他科学家利用这些新发现来服务于自身目的；最终，公众（包括其他科学家）获知这些新发现以及可能随之而来的技术。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S3.text: Within the complex social structure of the scientific community, researchers make discoveries; editors and reviewers act as gatekeepers by controlling the publication process; other scientists use the new finding to suit their own purposes; and finally, the public (including other scientists) receives the new discovery and possibly accompanying technology.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S3.translation: 在科学共同体这一复杂的社会结构中，研究者作出发现；编辑和审稿人通过掌控发表过程充当把关人；其他科学家利用这些新发现来服务于自身目的；最终，公众（包括其他科学家）获知这些新发现以及可能随之而来的技术。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S4.text: As a discovery claim works its way through the community, the interaction and confrontation between shared and competing beliefs about the science and the technology involved transforms an individual's discovery claim into the community's credible discovery.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S4.translation: 当一项发现主张在共同体中逐步传播时，围绕相关科学与技术的共有信念和相互竞争的信念之间的互动与交锋，会把个人的发现主张转变为共同体所认可的可信发现。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S4.text: As a discovery claim works its way through the community, the interaction and confrontation between shared and competing beliefs about the science and the technology involved transforms an individual's discovery claim into the community's credible discovery.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P3-S4.translation: 当一项发现主张在共同体中逐步传播时，围绕相关科学与技术的共有信念和相互竞争的信念之间的互动与交锋，会把个人的发现主张转变为共同体所认可的可信发现。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S1.text: Two paradoxes exist throughout this credibility process.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S1.translation: 这一可信度形成过程中始终存在两个悖论。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S1.text: Two paradoxes exist throughout this credibility process.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S1.translation: 这一可信度形成过程中始终存在两个悖论。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S2.text: First, scientific work tends to focus on some aspect of prevailing knowledge that is viewed as incomplete or incorrect.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S2.translation: 第一，科学工作往往聚焦于现行知识中被视为不完整或不正确的某个方面。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S2.text: First, scientific work tends to focus on some aspect of prevailing knowledge that is viewed as incomplete or incorrect.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S2.translation: 第一，科学工作往往聚焦于现行知识中被视为不完整或不正确的某个方面。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S3.text: Little reward accompanies duplication and confirmation of what is already known and believed.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S3.translation: 对已知已信之事进行重复和确认，几乎得不到什么回报。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S3.text: Little reward accompanies duplication and confirmation of what is already known and believed.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S3.translation: 对已知已信之事进行重复和确认，几乎得不到什么回报。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S4.text: The goal is new-search, not re-search.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S4.translation: 目标是“新探”，而不是“复查”。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S4.text: The goal is new-search, not re-search.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S4.translation: 目标是“新探”，而不是“复查”。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S5.text: Not surprisingly, newly published discovery claims and credible discoveries that appear to be important and convincing will always be open to challenge and potential modification or refutation by future researchers.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S5.translation: 毫不奇怪，新发表的发现主张，以及那些看似重要且令人信服的可信发现，都始终有可能受到后来研究者的挑战，并可能被修正或推翻。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S5.text: Not surprisingly, newly published discovery claims and credible discoveries that appear to be important and convincing will always be open to challenge and potential modification or refutation by future researchers.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S5.translation: 毫不奇怪，新发表的发现主张，以及那些看似重要且令人信服的可信发现，都始终有可能受到后来研究者的挑战，并可能被修正或推翻。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S6.text: Second, novelty itself frequently provokes disbelief.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S6.translation: 第二，新颖本身常常会引发怀疑。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S6.text: Second, novelty itself frequently provokes disbelief.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S6.translation: 第二，新颖本身常常会引发怀疑。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S7.text: Nobel Laureate and physiologist Albert Szent-Györgyi once described discovery as "seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought."
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S7.translation: 诺贝尔奖得主、生理学家阿尔伯特·圣捷尔吉曾把发现描述为“看到人人都看到的东西，想到无人想到的东西”。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S7.text: Nobel Laureate and physiologist Albert Szent-Györgyi once described discovery as "seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought."
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S7.translation: 诺贝尔奖得主、生理学家阿尔伯特·圣捷尔吉曾把发现描述为“看到人人都看到的东西，想到无人想到的东西”。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S8.text: But thinking what nobody else has thought and telling others what they have missed may not change their views.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S8.translation: 然而，想到别人没想到的东西，并把别人所忽视的告诉他们，未必能改变他们的看法。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S8.text: But thinking what nobody else has thought and telling others what they have missed may not change their views.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S8.translation: 然而，想到别人没想到的东西，并把别人所忽视的告诉他们，未必能改变他们的看法。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S9.text: Sometimes years are required for truly novel discovery claims to be accepted and appreciated.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S9.translation: 有时，真正新颖的发现主张要等到多年之后才被人们接受和认可。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S9.text: Sometimes years are required for truly novel discovery claims to be accepted and appreciated.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P4-S9.translation: 有时，真正新颖的发现主张要等到多年之后才被人们接受和认可。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P5-S1.text: In the end, credibility "happens" to a discovery claim -- a process that corresponds to what philosopher Annette Baier has described as the commons of the mind.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P5-S1.translation: 归根到底，可信度是“发生”在发现主张之上的——这一过程恰好契合哲学家安妮特·拜尔所说的“心智的公地”。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P5-S1.text: In the end, credibility "happens" to a discovery claim -- a process that corresponds to what philosopher Annette Baier has described as the commons of the mind.
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P5-S1.translation: 归根到底，可信度是“发生”在发现主张之上的——这一过程恰好契合哲学家安妮特·拜尔所说的“心智的公地”。

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P5-S2.text: "We reason together, challenge, revise, and complete each other's reasoning and each other's conceptions of reason."
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P5-S2.translation: “我们共同推理，相互挑战、修正并完善彼此的推理以及彼此对理性的理解。”

ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P5-S2.text: "We reason together, challenge, revise, and complete each other's reasoning and each other's conceptions of reason."
ky-en1-2012-r-t3#P5-S2.translation: “我们共同推理，相互挑战、修正并完善彼此的推理以及彼此对理性的理解。”

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S1.text: If the trade unionist Jimmy Hoffa were alive today, he would probably represent civil servants.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S1.translation: 如果工会领袖吉米·霍法今天还活着，他很可能会代表公务员群体。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S1.text: If the trade unionist Jimmy Hoffa were alive today, he would probably represent civil servants.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S1.translation: 如果工会领袖吉米·霍法今天还活着，他很可能会代表公务员群体。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S2.text: When Hoffa's Teamsters were in their prime in 1960, only one in ten American government workers belonged to a union; now 36% do.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S2.translation: 1960年霍法领导的卡车司机工会正处于鼎盛时期，当时美国政府雇员中只有十分之一加入了工会；如今这一比例已达36%。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S2.text: When Hoffa's Teamsters were in their prime in 1960, only one in ten American government workers belonged to a union; now 36% do.

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S3.text: In 2009 the number of unionists in America's public sector passed that of their fellow members in the private sector.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S3.translation: 2009年，美国公共部门的工会会员人数超过了私营部门的工会会员人数。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S3.text: In 2009 the number of unionists in America's public sector passed that of their fellow members in the private sector.

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S4.text: In Britain, more than half of public sector workers but only about 15% of private sector ones are unionized.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S4.translation: 在英国，公共部门半数以上的员工都加入了工会，而私营部门加入工会的比例只有约15%。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P1-S4.text: In Britain, more than half of public sector workers but only about 15% of private sector ones are unionized.

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S1.text: There are three reasons for the public sector unions' thriving.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S1.translation: 公共部门工会之所以蓬勃发展，有三方面原因。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S1.text: There are three reasons for the public sector unions' thriving.

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S2.text: First, they can shut things down without suffering much in the way of consequences.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S2.translation: 第一，他们可以让工作停摆，而自身几乎不必承担什么后果。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S2.text: First, they can shut things down without suffering much in the way of consequences.

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S3.text: Second, they are mostly bright and well-educated.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S3.translation: 第二，他们大多头脑聪明、受过良好教育。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S3.text: Second, they are mostly bright and well-educated.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S3.translation: 第二，他们大多头脑聪明、受过良好教育。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S4.text: A quarter of America's public sector workers have a university degree.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S4.translation: 美国公共部门员工中有四分之一拥有大学学历。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S4.text: A quarter of America's public sector workers have a university degree.

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S5.text: Third, they now dominate left-of-centre politics.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S5.translation: 第三，他们如今主导着中左翼政治。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S5.text: Third, they now dominate left-of-centre politics.

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S6.text: Some of their ties go back a long way.

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S7.text: Britain's Labor Party, as its name implies, has long been associated with trade unionism.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S7.translation: 英国工党正如其名称所暗示的那样，长期以来一直与工会运动关系密切。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S8.text: Its current leader, Ed Miliband, owes his position to votes from public sector unions.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P2-S8.translation: 工党现任领袖埃德·米利班德能坐上这个位置，靠的正是公共部门工会的选票。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P4-S3.translation: 政客们一再将公共部门的薪酬协议“后置”：一方面把工资涨幅控制在较低水平，另一方面却增加休假福利，尤其是本已相当优厚的养老金待遇。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P4-S3.text: Politicians have repeatedly "backloaded" public sector pay deals, keeping the pay increases modest but adding to holidays and especially pensions that are already generous.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P4-S3.translation: 政客们一再将公共部门的薪酬协议“后置”：一方面把工资涨幅控制在较低水平，另一方面却增加休假福利，尤其是本已相当优厚的养老金待遇。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P5-S1.text: Reform has been vigorously opposed, perhaps most notoriously in education, where charter schools, academies and merit pay all faced drawn-out battles.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P5-S1.translation: 改革一直遭到强烈反对，其中教育领域的情况或许最为臭名昭著——特许学校、学院制学校和绩效工资无一不遭遇了旷日持久的拉锯战。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P5-S2.text: Even though there is plenty of evidence that the quality of the teachers is the most important variable, teachers' unions have fought against getting rid of bad ones and promoting good ones.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P5-S2.translation: 尽管有大量证据表明教师素质是最重要的变量，但教师工会仍极力反对淘汰不称职者、提拔优秀者。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P6-S2.text: In Wisconsin the unions have rallied thousands of supporters against Scott Walker, the hardline Republican governor.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P6-S2.translation: 在威斯康星州，工会已经动员起数千名支持者，反对该州立场强硬的共和党州长斯科特·沃克。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P7-S1.text: John Donahue at Harvard's Kennedy School points out that the norms of culture in Western civil services suit those who want to stay put but is bad for high achievers.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P7-S1.translation: 哈佛大学肯尼迪政府学院的约翰·多纳休指出，西方公务员系统的文化规范适合那些想安于原位的人，却不利于业绩出众者。

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P7-S2.text: The only American public sector workers who earn well above $250,000 a year are university sports coaches and the president of the United States.

ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P7-S3.text: Bankers' fat pay packets have attracted much criticism, but a public sector system that does not reward high achievers may be a much bigger problem for America.
ky-en1-2012-r-t4#P7-S3.translation: 银行家的丰厚薪酬招致了大量批评，但一个不奖励业绩出众者的公共部门体制，可能才是美国面临的更大问题。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P1-S1.text: In the 2006 film version of The Devil Wears Prada, Miranda Priestly, played by Meryl Streep, scolds her unattractive assistant for imagining that high fashion doesn't affect her.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P1-S1.translation: 在2006年的电影版《穿普拉达的女魔头》中，梅丽尔·斯特里普饰演的米兰达·普里斯利训斥她那相貌平平的助理，因为助理自以为高级时尚与她毫无干系。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P1-S1.text: In the 2006 film version of The Devil Wears Prada, Miranda Priestly, played by Meryl Streep, scolds her unattractive assistant for imagining that high fashion doesn't affect her.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P1-S1.translation: 在2006年的电影版《穿普拉达的女魔头》中，梅丽尔·斯特里普饰演的米兰达·普里斯利训斥她那相貌平平的助理，因为助理自以为高级时尚与她毫无干系。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P1-S2.text: Priestly explains how the deep blue color of the assistant's sweater descended over the years from fashion shows to department stores and to the bargain bin in which the poor girl doubtless found her garment.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P1-S2.translation: 普里斯利解释了这位助理所穿毛衣的深蓝色是如何在过去几年间，从顶级时装秀逐级流向百货商店，再流落到特价卖场——而这个可怜的女孩无疑正是从那里的折价筐中淘到了这件衣服。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P1-S2.translation: 普里斯利解释了这位助理所穿毛衣的深蓝色是如何在过去几年间，从顶级时装秀逐级流向百货商店，再流落到特价卖场——而这个可怜的女孩无疑正是从那里的折价筐中淘到了这件衣服。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S1.text: This top-down conception of the fashion business couldn't be more out of date or at odds with the feverish world described in Overdressed, Elizabeth Cline's three-year indictment of "fast fashion".
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 时装界这种自上而下的传统观念早已彻底过时，且与伊丽莎白·克莱恩在《过度装扮》中所描绘的狂热世界格格不入——该书是她历时三年对‘快时尚’发起的一记沉重控诉。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S1.text: This top-down conception of the fashion business couldn't be more out of date or at odds with the feverish world described in Overdressed, Elizabeth Cline's three-year indictment of "fast fashion".
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S1.translation: 时装界这种自上而下的传统观念早已彻底过时，且与伊丽莎白·克莱恩在《过度装扮》中所描绘的狂热世界格格不入——该书是她历时三年对‘快时尚’发起的一记沉重控诉。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S2.text: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S2.translation: 在过去十年左右的时间里，技术的进步使Zara、H&M和优衣库等大众平价品牌能够更迅速地对潮流做出反应，并更精准地预判市场需求。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S2.text: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S2.translation: 在过去十年左右的时间里，技术的进步使Zara、H&M和优衣库等大众平价品牌能够更迅速地对潮流做出反应，并更精准地预判市场需求。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S3.text: Quicker turnarounds mean less wasted inventory, more frequent releases, and more profit.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S3.translation: 更快的货品周转意味着更少的库存浪费、更频繁的新品发售以及更丰厚的商业利润。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S3.text: Quicker turnarounds mean less wasted inventory, more frequent releases, and more profit.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S3.translation: 更快的货品周转意味着更少的库存浪费、更频繁的新品发售以及更丰厚的商业利润。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S4.text: These labels encourage style-conscious consumers to see clothes as disposable — meant to last only a wash or two, although they don't advertise that — and to renew their wardrobe every few weeks.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S4.translation: 这些品牌怂恿具有时尚意识的消费者将服装视为一次性用品——哪怕它们并不会公开做此类广告宣传，衣服设计初衷往往也只耐洗一两次——并诱导大家每隔几周就更新一次衣橱。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S4.text: These labels encourage style-conscious consumers to see clothes as disposable — meant to last only a wash or two, although they don't advertise that — and to renew their wardrobe every few weeks.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S4.translation: 这些品牌怂恿具有时尚意识的消费者将服装视为一次性用品——哪怕它们并不会公开做此类广告宣传，衣服设计初衷往往也只耐洗一两次——并诱导大家每隔几周就更新一次衣橱。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S5.text: By offering on-trend items at dirt-cheap prices, Cline argues, these brands have hijacked fashion cycles, shaking an industry long accustomed to a seasonal pace.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S5.translation: 克莱恩认为，通过以极其低廉的白菜价提供紧跟潮流的单品，这些品牌实质上劫持了时尚周期，彻底震颤并重塑了这个长期习惯于按季度运转的行业。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P2-S5.text: By offering on-trend items at dirt-cheap prices, Cline argues, these brands have hijacked fashion cycles, shaking an industry long accustomed to a seasonal pace.

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P3-S1.text: The victims of this revolution, of course, are not limited to designers.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 当然，这场快时尚革命的受害者绝不仅限于设计师群体。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P3-S1.text: The victims of this revolution, of course, are not limited to designers.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 当然，这场快时尚革命的受害者绝不仅限于设计师群体。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P3-S2.text: For H&M to offer a $ 5.95 knit miniskirt in all its 2,300-plus stores around the world, it must rely on low-wage overseas labor, order in volumes that strain natural resources, and use massive amounts of harmful chemicals.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: 若要让H&M在全球2300多家门店中供应售价仅为5.95美元的针织超短裙，它就必须仰仗海外低薪廉价劳工、以足以耗竭自然资源的体量大批下单，并耗用海量有害化学原料。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P4-S1.text: Overdressed is the fashion world's answer to consumer-activist bestsellers like Michael Pollan's The Omnivore's Dilemma.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P4-S1.translation: 《过度装扮》堪称时尚界的重磅力作，它呼应了迈克尔·波伦《杂食者的杂食困境》等针对消费者运动的畅销反思之作。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P4-S1.text: Overdressed is the fashion world's answer to consumer-activist bestsellers like Michael Pollan's The Omnivore's Dilemma.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P4-S1.translation: 《过度装扮》堪称时尚界的重磅力作，它呼应了迈克尔·波伦《杂食者的杂食困境》等针对消费者运动的畅销反思之作。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P4-S2.text: “Mass-produced clothing, like fast food, fills a hunger and need, yet is non-durable and wasteful,” Cline argues.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P4-S2.translation: 克莱恩直言：“流水线量产的成衣如同垃圾快餐，固然能填补一时之饥与物欲，但极不耐用且造成惊人的浪费。”

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P4-S2.text: “Mass-produced clothing, like fast food, fills a hunger and need, yet is non-durable and wasteful,” Cline argues.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P4-S2.translation: 克莱恩直言：“流水线量产的成衣如同垃圾快餐，固然能填补一时之饥与物欲，但极不耐用且造成惊人的浪费。”

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P4-S3.text: Americans, she finds, buy roughly 20 billion garments a year — about 64 items per person — and no matter how much they give away, this excess leads to waste.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P4-S3.translation: 她调查发现，美国人每年大约购买200亿件衣服——人均多达64件——而且无论他们捐赠送出多少，这种过度消费最终都无可避免地走向生态浪费。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P5-S1.text: Towards the end of Overdressed, Cline introduced her ideal, a Brooklyn woman named Sarah Kate Beaumont, who since 2008 has made all of her own clothes — and beautifully.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P5-S1.translation: 在《过度装扮》的收尾部分，克莱恩引出了自己心中的理想典范——一位名叫莎拉·凯特·博蒙特的布鲁克林女性，她自2008年起便纯手工缝制所有个人衣物，且款式极为精美。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P5-S1.text: Towards the end of Overdressed, Cline introduced her ideal, a Brooklyn woman named Sarah Kate Beaumont, who since 2008 has made all of her own clothes — and beautifully.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P5-S1.translation: 在《过度装扮》的收尾部分，克莱恩引出了自己心中的理想典范——一位名叫莎拉·凯特·博蒙特的布鲁克林女性，她自2008年起便纯手工缝制所有个人衣物，且款式极为精美。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P5-S2.text: But as Cline is the first to note, it took Beaumont decades to perfect her craft; her example can't be knocked off.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P5-S2.translation: 但正如克莱恩自己率先指出的那样，博蒙特花费了数十年时间才磨砺出精湛的制衣手艺；她的个体范例绝不可能被普通人轻易山寨复制。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P6-S1.text: Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment — including H&M, with its Conscious Collection line — Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P6-S1.translation: 尽管有几家快时尚公司已经采取措施试图遏制对劳工和生态环境的负面冲击——例如H&M推出了主打环保意识的‘Conscious Collection’系列——但克莱恩坚信，真正持久的变革唯有由消费者亲自驱动促成。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P6-S2.text: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P6-S2.translation: 她身上流露出了许多可持续发展倡导者共有的理想主义色彩，无论在食品领域还是在能源领域皆是如此。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P6-S2.text: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P6-S3.text: Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P6-S3.translation: 虚荣爱美乃是人性中恒久不变的常态；大众只有在自身承受不起不这么做的严重后果（或承受不起劣质恶果/经济代价）时，才会真正开始转向更加环保可持续的消费模式。

ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P6-S3.text: Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can't afford not to.
ky-en1-2013-r-t1#P6-S3.translation: 虚荣爱美乃是人性中恒久不变的常态；大众只有在自身承受不起不这么做的严重后果（或承受不起劣质恶果/经济代价）时，才会真正开始转向更加环保可持续的消费模式。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S1.text: An old saying has it that half of all advertising budgets are wasted — the trouble is, no one knows which half.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S1.translation: 有句老话说，所有广告预算中有一半都被浪费掉了——麻烦在于，没人知道究竟是哪一半。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S1.text: An old saying has it that half of all advertising budgets are wasted — the trouble is, no one knows which half.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S1.translation: 有句老话说，所有广告预算中有一半都被浪费掉了——麻烦在于，没人知道究竟是哪一半。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S2.text: In the internet age, at least in theory, this fraction can be much reduced.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S2.translation: 在互联网时代，至少在理论层面上，这一被浪费的比例可以被大幅削减。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S2.text: In the internet age, at least in theory, this fraction can be much reduced.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S2.translation: 在互联网时代，至少在理论层面上，这一被浪费的比例可以被大幅削减。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S3.text: By watching what people search for, click on and say online, companies can aim "behavioural" ads at those most likely to buy.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S3.translation: 通过追踪观察人们在线搜索、点击和谈论的内容，企业可以将‘行为定向广告’精准投向那些最有购买意向的潜在受众。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S3.text: By watching what people search for, click on and say online, companies can aim "behavioural" ads at those most likely to buy.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P1-S3.translation: 通过追踪观察人们在线搜索、点击和谈论的内容，企业可以将‘行为定向广告’精准投向那些最有购买意向的潜在受众。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P2-S1.text: In the past couple of weeks a quarrel has illustrated the value to advertisers of such fine-grained information: Should advertisers assume that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioural ads?
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P2-S1.translation: 在过去几周里，一场争吵凸显了这种细颗粒度信息对广告商的巨大价值：广告商究竟应该默认假定人们乐于被追踪并接收定向广告？

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P2-S1.text: In the past couple of weeks a quarrel has illustrated the value to advertisers of such fine-grained information: Should advertisers assume that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioural ads?
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P2-S1.translation: 在过去几周里，一场争吵凸显了这种细颗粒度信息对广告商的巨大价值：广告商究竟应该默认假定人们乐于被追踪并接收定向广告？

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P2-S2.text: Or should they have explicit permission?
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P2-S2.translation: 还是说他们必须事先获得用户的明确许可？

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P2-S2.text: Or should they have explicit permission?
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P2-S2.translation: 还是说他们必须事先获得用户的明确许可？

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S1.text: In December 2010 America's Federal Trade Commission (FTC) proposed adding a "do not track" (DNT) option to internet browsers, so that users could tell advertisers that they did not want to be followed.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S1.translation: 2010年12月，美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）提议在网络浏览器中增加‘禁止追踪’（DNT）选项，以便用户能够明确告知广告商自己不希望被窥探尾随。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S1.text: In December 2010 America's Federal Trade Commission (FTC) proposed adding a "do not track" (DNT) option to internet browsers, so that users could tell advertisers that they did not want to be followed.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S1.translation: 2010年12月，美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）提议在网络浏览器中增加‘禁止追踪’（DNT）选项，以便用户能够明确告知广告商自己不希望被窥探尾随。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S2.text: Microsoft's Internet Explorer and Apple's Safari both offer DNT; Google's Chrome is due to do so this year.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S2.translation: 微软的IE浏览器和苹果的Safari浏览器均已提供了DNT功能；谷歌的Chrome浏览器也预定将于今年跟进上线。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S2.text: Microsoft's Internet Explorer and Apple's Safari both offer DNT; Google's Chrome is due to do so this year.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S2.translation: 微软的IE浏览器和苹果的Safari浏览器均已提供了DNT功能；谷歌的Chrome浏览器也预定将于今年跟进上线。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S3.text: In February the FTC and Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA) agreed that the industry would get cracking on responding to DNT requests.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S3.translation: 今年2月，FTC与数字广告联盟（DAA）达成共识：整个广告行业将迅速采取行动，着手响应用户的DNT诉求。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S3.text: In February the FTC and Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA) agreed that the industry would get cracking on responding to DNT requests.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P3-S3.translation: 今年2月，FTC与数字广告联盟（DAA）达成共识：整个广告行业将迅速采取行动，着手响应用户的DNT诉求。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P4-S1.text: On May 31st Microsoft set off the row.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P4-S1.translation: 5月31日，微软挑起了这场风波争端。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P4-S1.text: On May 31st Microsoft set off the row.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P4-S1.translation: 5月31日，微软挑起了这场风波争端。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P4-S2.text: It said that Internet Explorer 10, the version due to appear with Windows 8, would have DNT as a default.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P4-S2.translation: 微软宣布，即将随Windows 8系统一同问世的IE10浏览器版本，将把DNT功能设为默认开启状态。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P4-S2.text: It said that Internet Explorer 10, the version due to appear with Windows 8, would have DNT as a default.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P4-S2.translation: 微软宣布，即将随Windows 8系统一同问世的IE10浏览器版本，将把DNT功能设为默认开启状态。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S1.translation: 广告商们对此大为惊恐。
广告商们对此大为惊恐。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S2.text: Human nature being what it is, most people stick with default settings.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S2.translation: 鉴于人性的本质使然，绝大多数人都会沿用系统的默认设置。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S2.text: Human nature being what it is, most people stick with default settings.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S2.translation: 鉴于人性的本质使然，绝大多数人都会沿用系统的默认设置。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S3.text: Few switch DNT on now, but if tracking is off it will stay off.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S3.translation: 如今很少有人会主动打开DNT开关，但如果追踪功能默认被关闭，它就将一直保持关闭状态。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S3.text: Few switch DNT on now, but if tracking is off it will stay off.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S3.translation: 如今很少有人会主动打开DNT开关，但如果追踪功能默认被关闭，它就将一直保持关闭状态。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S4.text: Bob Liodice, the chief executive of the Association of National Advertisers, says consumers will be worse off if the industry cannot collect information about their preferences.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S4.translation: 美国全国广告商协会首席执行官鲍勃·利奥迪斯表示，如果广告业无法搜集有关消费者偏好的信息，消费者的处境反而会更糟。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S4.text: Bob Liodice, the chief executive of the Association of National Advertisers, says consumers will be worse off if the industry cannot collect information about their preferences.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S4.translation: 美国全国广告商协会首席执行官鲍勃·利奥迪斯表示，如果广告业无法搜集有关消费者偏好的信息，消费者的处境反而会更糟。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S5.text: People will not get fewer ads, he says.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S5.translation: 他直言，大众收到的广告数量绝不会因此减少。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S5.text: People will not get fewer ads, he says.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S5.translation: 他直言，大众收到的广告数量绝不会因此减少。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S6.text: "They'll get less meaningful, less targeted ads."
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S6.translation: “他们只是会收到更多毫无意义、缺乏针对性的垃圾广告。”

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S6.text: "They'll get less meaningful, less targeted ads."
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P5-S6.translation: “他们只是会收到更多毫无意义、缺乏针对性的垃圾广告。”

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S1.text: It is not yet clear how advertisers will respond.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S1.translation: 广告商最终将如何应对，目前尚不明朗。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S1.text: It is not yet clear how advertisers will respond.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S1.translation: 广告商最终将如何应对，目前尚不明朗。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S2.text: Getting a DNT signal does not oblige anyone to stop tracking, although some companies have promised to do so.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S2.translation: 即便接收到DNT信号，也并不具有强制任何主体停止追踪的法律约束力，尽管有些企业曾做出过此类承诺。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S2.text: Getting a DNT signal does not oblige anyone to stop tracking, although some companies have promised to do so.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S2.translation: 即便接收到DNT信号，也并不具有强制任何主体停止追踪的法律约束力，尽管有些企业曾做出过此类承诺。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S3.text: Unable to tell whether someone really objects to behavioural ads or whether they are sticking with Microsoft's default, some may ignore a DNT signal and press on anyway.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S3.translation: 由于无法辨别究竟是某个用户真正反感行为定向广告，还是仅仅随波逐流沿用了微软的默认设置，部分广告商很可能会选择无视DNT信号并继续强行推进追踪。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S3.text: Unable to tell whether someone really objects to behavioural ads or whether they are sticking with Microsoft's default, some may ignore a DNT signal and press on anyway.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P6-S3.translation: 由于无法辨别究竟是某个用户真正反感行为定向广告，还是仅仅随波逐流沿用了微软的默认设置，部分广告商很可能会选择无视DNT信号并继续强行推进追踪。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S1.text: Also unclear is why Microsoft has gone it alone.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S1.translation: 同样令人费解的是，微软为何要如此特立独行、单打独斗。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S1.text: Also unclear is why Microsoft has gone it alone.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S1.translation: 同样令人费解的是，微软为何要如此特立独行、单打独斗。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S2.text: After all, it has an ad business too, which it says will comply with DNT requests, though it is still working out how.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S2.translation: 毕竟微软自己同样拥有广告业务，尽管它声称这些业务也将遵守DNT请求，但眼下它仍在琢磨具体的落实之法。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S2.text: After all, it has an ad business too, which it says will comply with DNT requests, though it is still working out how.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S2.translation: 毕竟微软自己同样拥有广告业务，尽管它声称这些业务也将遵守DNT请求，但眼下它仍在琢磨具体的落实之法。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S3.text: If it is trying to upset Google, which relies almost wholly on advertising, it has chosen an indirect method: There is no guarantee that DNT by default will become the norm.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S3.translation: 如果微软此举是试图打压重创几乎全靠广告收入维生的谷歌，那它选择的手段未免有些拐弯抹角：因为根本没有任何保证表明‘默认开启DNT’会成为全行业的通用规范。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S3.text: If it is trying to upset Google, which relies almost wholly on advertising, it has chosen an indirect method: There is no guarantee that DNT by default will become the norm.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S3.translation: 如果微软此举是试图打压重创几乎全靠广告收入维生的谷歌，那它选择的手段未免有些拐弯抹角：因为根本没有任何保证表明‘默认开启DNT’会成为全行业的通用规范。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S4.text: DNT does not seem an obviously huge selling point for Windows 8 — though the firm has compared some of its other products favorably with Google's on that count before.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S4.translation: DNT看起来绝非Windows 8的显著重大卖点——尽管该企业以往曾在那一方面（隐私安全方面）将其某些其他产品与谷歌进行过有利的对比宣传。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S4.text: DNT does not seem an obviously huge selling point for Windows 8 — though the firm has compared some of its other products favorably with Google's on that count before.
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S4.translation: DNT看起来绝非Windows 8的显著重大卖点——尽管该企业以往曾在那一方面（隐私安全方面）将其某些其他产品与谷歌进行过有利的对比宣传。

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S5.text: Brendon Lynch, Microsoft's chief privacy officer, blogged: "We believe consumers should have more control."
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S5.translation: 微软首席隐私官布伦登·林奇在博客中信誓旦旦地写道：“我们坚信，消费者理应拥有更多的自主控制权。”

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S5.translation: 微软首席隐私官布伦登·林奇在博客中信誓旦旦地写道：“我们坚信，消费者理应拥有更多的自主控制权。”

ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S6.text: Could it really be that simple?
ky-en1-2013-r-t2#P7-S6.translation: 可事情当真会如此单纯美好吗？

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P1-S1.text: Up until a few decades ago, our visions of the future were largely — though by no means uniformly — glowingly positive.
ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P1-S1.translation: 直到几十年前，我们对未来的憧憬在很大程度上——尽管绝非毫无例外地完全一致——都是极其乐观洋溢的。

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P1-S1.text: Up until a few decades ago, our visions of the future were largely — though by no means uniformly — glowingly positive.
ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P1-S1.translation: 直到几十年前，我们对未来的憧憬在很大程度上——尽管绝非毫无例外地完全一致——都是极其乐观洋溢的。

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P1-S2.text: Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfillment and opportunity for all.
ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P1-S2.translation: 科学与技术将治愈人类社会的一切弊病，为所有人带来充实完满、机遇无限的美好生活。

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P1-S2.text: Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfillment and opportunity for all.

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P2-S1.text: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.
ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P2-S1.translation: 而今乌托邦式的幻想已不再受人青睐，因为我们对自身所面临的各种威胁有了更深刻的体认——从小行星撞击、恶性流感大流行到全球气候变化。

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P2-S1.text: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P2-S2.text: You might even be tempted to assume that humanity has little future to look forward to.
ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 人们甚至可能忍不住会认定，人类已然没有什么值得翘首以盼的未来可言。

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P2-S2.text: You might even be tempted to assume that humanity has little future to look forward to.

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P3-S1.translation: 然而，这种阴郁沮丧的悲观情绪完全是被错置了。

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P3-S2.text: The fossil record shows that many species have endured for millions of years — so why shouldn't we?
ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P3-S2.translation: 化石记录清晰地表明，许多物种都已在地球上延续生存了数百万年之久——既然如此，我们人类又为何不可呢？

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P3-S2.text: The fossil record shows that many species have endured for millions of years — so why shouldn't we?

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P3-S3.text: Take a broader look at our species’ place in the universe, and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years.
ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P3-S3.translation: 若从更宽广的宇宙视域来审视人类物种的地位，事实便一目了然：即便谈不上生存几十万年，我们也完全拥有生存数万年的绝佳机会。

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P3-S4.text: Look up Homo sapiens in the "Red List" of threatened species of the International Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN) and you will read: “Listed as Least Concern as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline.”

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P4-S3.text: For example, the Long Now Foundation has as its flagship project a mechanical clock that is designed to still be marking time thousands of years hence.

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P5-S2.text: The potential evolution of today's technology, and its social consequences, is dazzlingly complicated, and it's perhaps best left to science fiction writers and futurologists to explore the many possibilities we can envisage.

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P5-S3.text: That's one reason why we have launched Arc, a new publication dedicated to the near future.
ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P5-S3.translation: 这正是我们推出《Arc》新刊物的缘由之一，这是一份专门聚焦并致力于探讨近期未来的崭新出版物。

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P6-S1.text: But take a longer view and there is a surprising amount that we can say with considerable assurance.
ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P6-S1.translation: 然而，一旦我们放眼长远，便会惊讶地发现，有诸多未来走向是我们能够带着相当大的笃定把握加以言说的。

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P6-S2.text: As so often, the past holds the key to the future: we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.
ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P6-S2.translation: 正如历史屡次印证的那样，过去掌握着通向未来的钥匙：如今我们已经探明了足够多塑造地球和人类物种历史的长期规律，从而能够对未来子孙后代所处的境况做出有凭有据的科学预测。

ky-en1-2013-r-t3#P7-S1.text: This long perspective makes the pessimistic view of our prospects seem more likely to be a passing fad.

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P1-S1.text: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday — a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P1-S1.translation: 周一，联邦最高法院以5比3的表决结果推翻了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分条款——这对于奥巴马政府而言是一场微不足道的政策小胜。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P1-S1.text: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday — a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P1-S1.translation: 周一，联邦最高法院以5比3的表决结果推翻了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分条款——这对于奥巴马政府而言是一场微不足道的政策小胜。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P1-S2.text: But on the more important matter of the Constitution, the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration’s effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P1-S2.translation: 但在事关宪法这一更为重大的根本原则上，该判决对于奥巴马政府企图打破联邦政府与各州之间权力平衡的图谋而言，却是一场8比0的彻头彻尾的惨败。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P1-S2.text: But on the more important matter of the Constitution, the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration’s effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P1-S2.translation: 但在事关宪法这一更为重大的根本原则上，该判决对于奥巴马政府企图打破联邦政府与各州之间权力平衡的图谋而言，却是一场8比0的彻头彻尾的惨败。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S1.text: In Arizona v. United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona's controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigrations law.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S1.translation: 在‘亚利桑那州诉联邦政府’一案中，多数派大法官推翻了亚利桑那州引发争议的法案中四项受质疑条款中的三项，该法案企图责成州和地方警察来执行联邦移民法。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S1.text: In Arizona v. United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona's controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigrations law.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S1.translation: 在‘亚利桑那州诉联邦政府’一案中，多数派大法官推翻了亚利桑那州引发争议的法案中四项受质疑条款中的三项，该法案企图责成州和地方警察来执行联邦移民法。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S2.text: The Constitutional principles that Washington alone has the power to "establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization" and that federal laws precede state laws are noncontroversial.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S2.translation: 唯有华盛顿联邦政府独享‘确立全国统一的归化入籍规则’的权力，以及联邦法律的法律效力高于各州法律，这两大宪法原则是无可争议的公理。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S2.text: The Constitutional principles that Washington alone has the power to "establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization" and that federal laws precede state laws are noncontroversial.

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S3.text: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S3.translation: 亚利桑那州此前却企图制定出一套与现行联邦法律亦步亦趋、相提并论的平行州政策。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S3.text: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P2-S3.translation: 亚利桑那州此前却企图制定出一套与现行联邦法律亦步亦趋、相提并论的平行州政策。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P3-S1.text: Justice Anthony Kennedy, joined by Chief Justice John Roberts and the Court's liberals, ruled that the state flew too close to the federal sun.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P3-S1.translation: 安东尼·肯尼迪大法官在首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨及高院自由派法官的赞同附议下做出裁定：该州的立法行径犹如伊卡洛斯，飞得离联邦太阳太近了。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P3-S1.text: Justice Anthony Kennedy, joined by Chief Justice John Roberts and the Court's liberals, ruled that the state flew too close to the federal sun.

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P3-S2.text: On the overturned provisions the majority held that Congress had deliberately "occupied the field" and Arizona had thus intruded on the federal's privileged powers.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P3-S2.translation: 对于被推翻的那些条款，多数派大法官判定国会早已深思熟虑地对该领域实现了‘全域先占’，因此亚利桑那州侵犯了联邦独享的专有特权。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P4-S1.text: However, the Justices said that Arizona police would be allowed to verify the legal status of people who come in contact with law enforcement.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P4-S1.translation: 然而，大法官们明确表示，亚利桑那州警察有权核查在日常执法接触中所遭遇人员的合法移民身份。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P4-S1.text: However, the Justices said that Arizona police would be allowed to verify the legal status of people who come in contact with law enforcement.

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P4-S2.text: That’s because Congress has always envisioned joint federal-state immigration enforcement and explicitly encourages state officers to share information and cooperate with federal colleagues.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P4-S2.translation: 这是因为国会历来都设想推行联邦与各州联合移民执法，并且明文鼓励各州执法官员与联邦同行共享情报信息、紧密合作。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P5-S1.text: Two of the three objecting Justices — Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas — agreed with this Constitutional logic but disagreed about which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P5-S1.translation: 在三位持异议的大法官中，有两位——塞缪尔·阿利托和克拉伦斯·托马斯——完全认同这一宪法逻辑，但在亚利桑那州的具体哪些法规与联邦成文法相冲突这一问题上存有分歧。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P5-S1.text: Two of the three objecting Justices — Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas — agreed with this Constitutional logic but disagreed about which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P5-S1.translation: 在三位持异议的大法官中，有两位——塞缪尔·阿利托和克拉伦斯·托马斯——完全认同这一宪法逻辑，但在亚利桑那州的具体哪些法规与联邦成文法相冲突这一问题上存有分歧。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P5-S2.text: The only major objection came from Justice Antonin Scalia, who offered an even more robust defense of state privileges going back to the Alien and Sedition Acts.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P5-S2.translation: 唯一重大的根本性异议来自安东宁·斯卡利亚大法官，他立足于追溯至建国初期《外侨与煽动叛乱法案》的历史渊源，为各州的固有特权做出了更为强劲有力的辩护。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P6-S1.text: The 8-0 objection to President Obama turns on what Justice Samuel Alito describes in his objection as “a shocking assertion of federal executive power”.
ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P6-S1.translation: 大法官以8比0全票反对奥巴马总统，其关键核心在于塞缪尔·阿利托大法官在其异议意见书中所痛斥的“一项对联邦行政权令人震惊的专断主张”。

ky-en1-2013-r-t4#P6-S2.translation: 白宫此前强词夺理地辩称：哪怕亚利桑那州的州法在字面上丝毫不差地完全遵守了联邦法条，也依然违背了白宫自身设定的执法轻重缓急优先次序。

ky-en1-2014-r-t2#P3-S2.text: One is the excessive costs of a legal education.

ky-en1-2014-r-t2#P3-S2.translation: 首要原因之一，便是法律专业教育本身过于高昂的就读成本。

ky-en1-2014-r-t2#P3-S3.text: There is just one path for a lawyer in most American states: a four-year undergraduate degree in some unrelated subject, then a three-year law degree at one of 200 law schools authorized by the American Bar Association and an expensive preparation for the bar exam.
ky-en1-2014-r-t2#P3-S3.translation: 在全美绝大多数州，通往执业律师的道路只有千篇一律的一条：先攻读四年毫不相干的本科专业学位，继而在全美律师协会认可的200所高价法学院中任选一所攻读三年法律学位，最后再斥巨资参加司法考试考前培训班。

ky-en1-2014-r-t2#P4-S2.text: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
ky-en1-2014-r-t2#P4-S2.translation: 许多切合实际的合理构想早已存在多时，然而掌管该行业的各州监管机构却思想过于僵化保守，根本不愿予以采纳实施。

ky-en1-2014-r-t2#P4-S5.text: If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so.

ky-en1-2014-r-t3#P3-S2.translation: 有的旨在语不惊人死不休地制造轰动效应，有的试图吸引公众投身科学殿堂，还有的则是为了更好地奖赏那些毕生致力于科研事业的学者。

ky-en1-2014-r-t3#P4-S1.text: As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes — both new and old — are distributed.
ky-en1-2014-r-t3#P4-S1.translation: 正如《自然》杂志先前所指出的那样，关于各大科学奖项——无论新设大奖还是百年老奖——究竟应当如何遴选颁发，确实存在一些合情合理的合理关切。

ky-en1-2014-r-t3#P4-S2.text: The Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, launched this year, takes an unrepresentative view of what the life sciences include.
ky-en1-2014-r-t3#P4-S2.translation: 今年新鲜出炉的“生命科学突破奖”，其对生命科学应涵盖学科范畴的界定就显失偏颇、缺乏广泛代表性。

ky-en1-2014-r-t3#P4-S3.text: But the Nobel Foundation's limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must still be living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research — as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson.
ky-en1-2014-r-t3#P4-S3.translation: 然而，诺贝尔基金会所定下的单项奖得主不得超过三人且每位必须健在的死板陈规，早已远远落后于现代科研讲求多方大规模协同协作的本质——正如一旦论及对希格斯玻色子发现的功绩表彰时，必将不可避免地掀起一场关于究竟是哪位关键科学家遭到了无端漠视与遗忘的激烈论战所生动印证的那样。

ky-en1-2014-r-t3#P5-S3.translation: 其二，巨额财富与社会聚光灯能够汇流涌向科学殿堂而非挥霍他处，这无论如何都是一件利国利民的大好事。

ky-en1-2014-r-t3#P5-S4.text: It is fair to criticize and question the mechanism — that is the culture of research, after all — but it is the prize-givers' money to do with as they please.

ky-en1-2014-r-t4#P1-S1.text: "The Heart of the Matter," the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.

ky-en1-2014-r-t4#P2-S1.text: In 2010, leading congressional Democrats and Republicans sent letters to the AAAS asking that it identify actions that could be taken by "federal, state and local governments, universities, foundations, educators, individual benefactors and others" to "maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education."
ky-en1-2014-r-t4#P2-S1.translation: 2010年，美国国会两党领袖联名致信美国人文与科学院，要求其明确指出可由“联邦、州和地方政府、高校、基金会、教育工作者、个人捐助者以及其他群体”采取的具体行动，以此“维护国家在人文与社会科学学术研究和教育领域的卓越领先地位”。

ky-en1-2014-r-t4#P3-S2.text: Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy; stresses the study of history and government, particularly American history and American government; and encourages the use of new digital technologies.
ky-en1-2014-r-t4#P3-S2.translation: 鉴于代议制政府以具备充分知情素养的公民为前提条件，该报告倡导普及全面识字与人文通识教育；强调历史与政治制度的学习，尤其是对美国历史与美国政府体制的研究；并鼓励新兴数字技术的应用。

ky-en1-2014-r-t4#P3-S3.text: To encourage innovation and competition, the report calls for increased investment in research, the crafting of coherent curricula that improve students' ability to solve problems and communicate effectively in the 21st century, increased funding for teachers and the encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day.
ky-en1-2014-r-t4#P3-S3.translation: 为激励创新与竞争力，报告呼吁加大对科研的投入，精心打磨连贯系统的课程体系以提升学生在21世纪有效解决问题与沟通交流的能力，增加对教师的资金扶持，并鼓励学者们将学术成果应用于应对当今时代的重大挑战。

ky-en1-2014-r-t4#P4-S1.text: Unfortunately, despite 2.5 years in the making, "The Heart of the Matter" never gets to the heart of the matter: the illiberal nature of liberal education at our leading colleges and universities.

ky-en1-2014-r-t4#P5-S1.text: Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas — such as free markets and self-reliance — as falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.

ky-en1-2015-r-t1#P3-S1.text: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.
ky-en1-2015-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 正是这种在政治上显而易见的超脱性，解释了君主作为国家元首为何能够享有持久的拥戴。

ky-en1-2015-r-t1#P3-S1.text: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.

ky-en1-2015-r-t1#P3-S2.text: And so, the Middle East excepted, Europe is the most monarch-infested region in the world, with 10 kingdoms (not counting Vatican City and Andorra).
ky-en1-2015-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: 因此，除中东地区以外，欧洲是世界上君主政体最为密集泛滥的地区，拥有多达10个王国（尚不计梵蒂冈城国与安道尔公国）。

ky-en1-2015-r-t1#P3-S3.text: But unlike their absolutist counterparts in the Gulf and Asia, most royal families have survived because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure.
ky-en1-2015-r-t1#P3-S3.translation: 但与海湾和亚洲地区的专制君主不同，欧洲绝大多数王室之所以得以幸存，是因为他们使选民免去了费力寻找一位无可置疑且备受尊重的公众人物的麻烦。

ky-en1-2015-r-t1#P4-S3.text: At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.

ky-en1-2015-r-t2#P6-S3.text: They could still invalidate Fourth Amendment protections when facing severe, urgent circumstances, and they could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant.

ky-en1-2015-r-t2#P7-S3.text: Orin Kerr, a law professor, compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use as a virtual necessity of life in the 20th: The justices had to specify novel rules for the new personal domain of the passenger car then; they must sort out how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information now.
ky-en1-2015-r-t2#P7-S3.translation: 法学教授奥林·克尔将21世纪数字信息的爆炸性增长与极易获取性，与20世纪汽车被确立为实质上的生活必需品进行了深刻类比：当年，大法官们不得不为私家轿车这一崭新的个人隐私领域量身确立开创性规则；而今天，他们同样必须彻底厘清第四修正案应当如何切实适用于全新的数字信息时代。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P1-S1.text: The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P1-S1.translation: 《科学》杂志总编辑玛西娅·麦克纳特今日宣布，该期刊将在其常规同行评审流程中增加一轮额外的统计学专项审查。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P1-S1.text: The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P1-S1.translation: 《科学》杂志总编辑玛西娅·麦克纳特今日宣布，该期刊将在其常规同行评审流程中增加一轮额外的统计学专项审查。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P1-S2.text: The policy follows similar efforts from other journals, after widespread concern that basic mistakes in data analysis are contributing to the irreproducibility of many published research findings.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P1-S2.translation: 在学界普遍忧虑数据分析中的基础性低级错误正导致大批已发表科研成果无法复制之后，该政策效仿了其他期刊所采取的类似举措。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P1-S2.text: The policy follows similar efforts from other journals, after widespread concern that basic mistakes in data analysis are contributing to the irreproducibility of many published research findings.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P1-S2.translation: 在学界普遍忧虑数据分析中的基础性低级错误正导致大批已发表科研成果无法复制之后，该政策效仿了其他期刊所采取的类似举措。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S1.text: "Readers must have confidence in the conclusions published in our journal," writes McNutt in an editorial.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S1.translation: 麦克纳特在一篇社论中写道：“读者必须对发表在我们杂志上的科研结论抱有充分的信心。”

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S1.text: "Readers must have confidence in the conclusions published in our journal," writes McNutt in an editorial.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S1.translation: 麦克纳特在一篇社论中写道：“读者必须对发表在我们杂志上的科研结论抱有充分的信心。”

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S2.text: Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistics board of reviewing editors (SBoRE).
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 通过与美国统计协会携手合作，《科学》杂志已任命了七位资深专家，组建了“统计审查编辑委员会”（简称SBoRE）。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S2.text: Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistics board of reviewing editors (SBoRE).
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 通过与美国统计协会携手合作，《科学》杂志已任命了七位资深专家，组建了“统计审查编辑委员会”（简称SBoRE）。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S3.text: Manuscripts will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal's internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S3.translation: 投递的论文稿件如果被该刊的内部编辑、既有的审稿编辑委员会或外部同行评议人标出存在疑点，将接受额外的严密审查。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S4.text: The SBoRE panel will then find external statisticians to review these manuscripts.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S4.translation: 随后，SBoRE专家小组物色外部专业统计学家来专门复核审阅这些问题论文稿件。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S4.text: The SBoRE panel will then find external statisticians to review these manuscripts.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P2-S4.translation: 随后，SBoRE专家小组物色外部专业统计学家来专门复核审阅这些问题论文稿件。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P3-S1.text: Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change, McNutt said: "The creation of the 'statistics board' was motivated by concerns broadly with the application of statistics and data analysis in scientific research and is part of Science's overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish."
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P3-S1.translation: 在被问及是否是由某些特定论文触发了这项政策变革时，麦克纳特回应道：“设立‘统计委员会’是源于学界对统计学与数据分析在科研中广泛应用的深切关切，这也是《科学》杂志为提升所发表论文研究可重复性而做出的全面努力的一部分。”

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P3-S1.text: Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change, McNutt said: "The creation of the 'statistics board' was motivated by concerns broadly with the application of statistics and data analysis in scientific research and is part of Science's overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish."

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P4-S1.text: Giovanni Parmigiani, a biostatistician at the Harvard School of Public Health, a member of the SBoRE group, says he expects the board to "play primarily an advisory role."
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P4-S1.translation: 哈佛大学公共卫生学院生物统计学家、SBoRE专家组成员乔瓦尼·帕玛强尼表示，他期望该委员会“主要发挥顾问咨询作用”。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P4-S1.translation: 哈佛大学公共卫生学院生物统计学家、SBoRE专家组成员乔瓦尼·帕玛强尼表示，他期望该委员会“主要发挥顾问咨询作用”。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P5-S1.text: John Ioannidis, a physician who studies research methodology at Stanford University in California, says that the policy is "a most welcome step forward" and "long overdue."

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P5-S2.text: "Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P5-S2.translation: “绝大多数学术期刊在统计学审查方面都极其薄弱，而这直接损害了它们所刊发学术论文的质量。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P5-S2.text: "Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish.

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P5-S3.text: I think that, for the majority of scientific papers nowadays, statistical review is more essential than expert review," he says.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P5-S3.translation: 我认为，对于当今的绝大多数科学论文而言，统计审查甚至比传统的专家同行评审更为不可或缺。”他说道。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P5-S4.text: But he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P5-S4.translation: 不过他也指出，诸如《内科学年鉴》、《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》等顶级生物医学期刊一直对统计审查高度重视。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P6-S1.text: Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyze data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist.
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P6-S1.translation: 细胞生物学家大卫·沃克斯指出，专业科研工作者理应懂得如何规范分析数据，然而在已经发表的学术研究成果中，统计学错误之普遍达到了令人触目惊心的地步。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P6-S2.text: Researchers should improve their standards, he wrote in 2012, but journals should also take a tougher line, "engaging reviewers who are statistically literate and editors who can verify the process".
ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P6-S2.translation: 他在2012年撰文指出，科研人员应当提升自身专业准则，但学术期刊同样理应采取更加强硬严厉的举措，“引入精通统计学的审稿人以及能够对统计流程进行专业核实的编辑”。

ky-en1-2015-r-t3#P6-S3.text: Vaux says that Science's idea to pass some papers to statisticians "has some merit, but a weakness is that it relies on the board of reviewing editors to identify 'the papers that need scrutiny' in the first place".

ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P1-S1.translation: 两年前，鲁伯特·默多克的女儿伊丽莎白谈到了“在我们众多社会机构中普遍存在的令人不安的诚信缺失现象”。

ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P1-S2.text: Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only "sorting mechanism" in society should be profit and the market.
ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P1-S2.translation: 她辩称，诚信正直之所以崩塌，是因为全社会集体默认并接受了这样一种观念：社会中唯一合理有效的分选与筛选机制应当是利润与市场。

ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P1-S2.text: Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only "sorting mechanism" in society should be profit and the market.

ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P1-S3.text: But "it's us, human beings, we the people who create the society we want, not profit".
ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P1-S3.translation: 然而，“恰恰是我们人类自己，是我们大众人民在创造我们所期盼的社会形态，而不是冷冰冰的利润”。

ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P2-S1.text: Driving her point home, she continued: "It's increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom."
ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P2-S1.translation: 为了进一步把论点阐释得彻底透彻，她接着指出：“日益显而易见的是，在政府、媒体或商业机构内部道德使命与伦理语言的全面缺失，可能成为资本主义与自由体系最为危险的致命威胁。”

ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P2-S2.text: This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.
ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P2-S2.translation: 她认为，正是这种道德宗旨的缺失正在严重侵蚀伤害着诸如新闻国际这样的企业，使之极有可能彻底误入歧途，正如该公司在广泛的非法电话窃听事件中所暴露出的一样。

ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P3-S1.text: As the hacking trial concludes — finding guilty one ex-editor of the News of the World, Andy Coulson, for conspiring to hack phones, and finding his predecessor, Rebekah Brooks, innocent of the same charge — the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands.
ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P3-S1.translation: 随着这场举世瞩目的电话窃听案审判尘埃落定——《世界新闻报》前主编安迪·库尔森被判串谋窃听电话罪名成立，而他的前任丽贝卡·布鲁克斯却被判免于该项罪责——然而，更广泛维度的诚信缺失问题依然昭然若揭。

ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P3-S1.text: As the hacking trial concludes — finding guilty one ex-editor of the News of the World, Andy Coulson, for conspiring to hack phones, and finding his predecessor, Rebekah Brooks, innocent of the same charge — the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands.

ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P3-S2.text: Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5,500 people. This is hacking on an industrial scale, as was acknowledged by Glenn Mulcaire, the man hired by the News of the World in 2001 to be the point person for phone hacking.

ky-en1-2015-r-t4#P4-S2.text: One of the astonishing revelations was how little Rebekah Brooks knew of what went on in her newsroom, how little she thought to ask and the fact that she never inquired how the stories arrived.

ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P1-S2.text: Its lawmakers gave preliminary approval last week to a law that would make it a crime to employ ultra-thin models on runways.

ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P1-S3.text: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that incite "excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.

ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P2-S1.text: Such measures have a couple of uplifting motives.

ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P2-S2.text: They suggest beauty should not be defined by looks that end up impinging on health. That's a start.
ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P2-S2.translation: 它们表明，美不应当由最终损害健康的病态外表来界定。这是一个良好的开端。

ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P2-S3.text: And the ban on ultra-thin models seems to go beyond protecting models from starving themselves to death — as some have done.
ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P2-S3.translation: 而且，对纸片人模特的禁令似乎不仅保护模特免于将自己活活饿死——正如一些模特过去所经历的那样。

ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P2-S4.text: It tells the fashion industry that it must take responsibility for the signal it sends women, especially teenage girls, about the social tape-measure they must use to determine their individual worth.
ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P2-S4.translation: 它告诫时尚界，必须对向女性（尤其是少女群体）传递的信号承担责任，因为那是她们衡量自身个人价值的社会尺度。

ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P3-S1.text: The bans, if fully enforced, would suggest to women (and many men) that they should not let others be arbiters of their beauty.
ky-en1-2016-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 这些禁令如果能够全面贯彻执行，将向女性（以及许多男性）传递一个理念：不应任由他人充当自己美丽的仲裁者。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P1-S3.text: But even if you accept Friedman's premise and regard corporate social responsibility (CSR) policies as a waste of shareholders' money, things may not be absolutely clear-cut.

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P1-S4.text: New research suggests that CSR may create monetary value for companies in at least one relatively untracked way: by smoothing their path on the occasions when they fall foul of the law.

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S1.text: The largest firms in America and Britain together spend more than $15 billion a year on CSR, according to an estimate by EPG, a consulting firm.
ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S1.translation: 据咨询公司EPG的测算，美英两国规模最大的顶尖企业每年在CSR项目上的总支出超过150亿美元。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S1.text: The largest firms in America and Britain together spend more than $15 billion a year on CSR, according to an estimate by EPG, a consulting firm.

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S2.text: This could add value to their businesses in three ways.
ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 这一庞大投入可通过三种机制为企业业务增加价值。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S2.text: This could add value to their businesses in three ways.
ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 这一庞大投入可通过三种机制为企业业务增加价值。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S3.text: First, consumers may take CSR spending as a signal that a company's products are of high quality.
ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S3.translation: 首先，消费者可能会将企业在CSR上的巨额投入视为其产品具有卓越高品质的有力信号。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S3.text: First, consumers may take CSR spending as a signal that a company's products are of high quality.
ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S3.translation: 首先，消费者可能会将企业在CSR上的巨额投入视为其产品具有卓越高品质的有力信号。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S4.text: Second, customers may be willing to buy a company's products as an indirect way to donate to the good causes it helps.
ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S4.translation: 其次，顾客可能乐于购买该公司的产品，以此作为向其所资助的崇高慈善事业进行间接捐赠的一种途径。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S5.text: And third, through a more diffuse halo effect whereby its good deeds earn it greater consideration from consumers and others.
ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P2-S5.translation: 第三，则是通过一种更为广泛弥散的‘光环效应’（halo effect），使企业的行善义举为其从消费者及全社会其他利益相关方处赢得更多善意关照与信任好感。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P3-S1.text: Previous studies on CSR have had trouble differentiating these effects because consumers can be affected by all three.
ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P3-S1.translation: 以往关于CSR的研究难以将这三种效应清晰剥离区分，因为普通消费者可能会同时受到这三种机制的综合交织影响。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P3-S2.text: A recent study attempts to separate them by looking at bribery prosecutions under America's Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA).
ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P3-S2.translation: 而一项最新研究另辟蹊径，试图通过审视依据美国《反海外腐败法》（FCPA）提起的海外商业行贿起诉案件，将这些效应剥离开来。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P3-S3.text: It argues that since prosecutors do not consume a company's products as part of their investigations, they could be influenced only by the halo effect.

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P4-S1.text: The study found that, among prosecuted firms, those with the most comprehensive CSR programmes tended to get more lenient penalties.
ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P4-S1.translation: 这项实证研究发现：在遭到FCPA起诉的涉案企业中，那些拥有最健全完善CSR项目的公司，往往能获得显著更为轻微宽大的司法处罚。

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P4-S1.text: The study found that, among prosecuted firms, those with the most comprehensive CSR programmes tended to get more lenient penalties.

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P4-S2.text: Their analysis ruled out the possibility that it was firms' political influence, rather than their CSR stand, that accounted for the leniency: Companies that contributed more to political campaigns did not receive lower fines.

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P5-S1.text: In all, the study concludes that whereas prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits, they do seem to be influenced by a company's record in CSR.

ky-en1-2016-r-t3#P5-S2.text: "We estimate that either eliminating a substantial labour-rights concern, such as child labour, or increasing corporate giving by about 20% results in fines that generally are 40% lower than the typical punishment for bribing foreign officials," says one researcher.

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P3-S1.text: Last year, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons—both fake and real—past airport security nearly every time they tried.
ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P3-S1.translation: 去年，美国运输安全管理局（TSA）在一次秘密检查中发现，卧底调查员能够携带武器（不管真假）成功通过机场安检，几乎屡试不爽。

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P3-S1.text: Last year, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons—both fake and real—past airport security nearly every time they tried.

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P3-S2.text: Enhanced security measures since then, combined with a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices, have resulted in long waits at major airports such as Chicago's O'Hare International.
ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P3-S2.translation: 自那以后安全措施加强，加上航空旅行人数因为经济好转和低油价上升，导致芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场等主要机场等候时间过长。

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P3-S2.text: Enhanced security measures since then, combined with a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices, have resulted in long waits at major airports such as Chicago's O'Hare International.

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P3-S3.text: It is not yet clear how much more effective airline security has become—but the lines are obvious.
ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P3-S3.translation: 航空安检的有效性提升了多少尚不清楚——但是安检队伍变长是显而易见的。

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P4-S1.text: Part of the issue is that the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel, so the TSA is now rushing to get new screeners on the line.
ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P4-S1.translation: 部分问题在于，政府没有预料到航空旅行人数会大幅增加，因此运输安全管理局正在加紧招募新的机场安检员。

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P4-S2.text: Part of the issue is that airports have only so much room for screening lanes.

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P4-S3.text: Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checked-baggage fees, though the airlines strongly dispute this.
ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P4-S3.translation: 另一个原因可能是，越来越多的人为了避免支付托运行李费，试图把随身行李塞得过满，不过航空公司对此说法强烈否认。

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P5-S1.text: There is one step the TSA could take that would not require remodeling airports or rushing to hire: Enroll more people in the PreCheck program.
ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P5-S1.translation: TSA可以采取一项措施，且不需要改造机场或急聘员工：那就是将更多人纳入预安检计划。

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P5-S2.text: PreCheck is supposed to be a win-win for travelers and the TSA.

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P5-S3.text: Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes.
ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P5-S3.translation: 通过了背景调查的旅客有资格使用快速安检通道。

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P5-S3.text: Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes.

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P5-S4.text: This allows the TSA to focus on travelers who are higher risk, saving time for everyone involved.

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P6-S1.text: It has not gotten anywhere close to that, and one big reason is sticker shock: Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks.
ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P6-S1.translation: 我们离这目标还很远，一大原因就是标价冲击波：乘客每五年必须缴纳85美元才能进行背景调查。

ky-en1-2017-r-t1#P6-S3.text: Upcoming reforms might bring the price to a more reasonable level.

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P1-S1.text: "The ancient Hawaiians were astronomers," wrote Queen Liliuokalani, Hawaii's last reigning monarch, in 1897.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P1-S1.translation: “古代夏威夷人都是天文学家”，夏威夷最后一位执政君主利留卡拉尼女王于1897年写道。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P1-S2.text: Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society.

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P1-S3.text: Sadly, all is not well with astronomy in Hawaii today.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P1-S3.translation: 遗憾的是，在现如今的夏威夷，天文学的发展并不尽如人意。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P1-S3.text: Sadly, all is not well with astronomy in Hawaii today.

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P1-S4.text: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity's view of the cosmos.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P1-S4.translation: 当地已经爆发了抗议活动，反对建造三十米望远镜（TMT）——一个可能会彻底改变人类对宇宙认识和看法的巨型天文台。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P1-S4.text: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity's view of the cosmos.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P1-S4.translation: 当地已经爆发了抗议活动，反对建造三十米望远镜（TMT）——一个可能会彻底改变人类对宇宙认识和看法的巨型天文台。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P2-S1.text: At issue is the TMT's planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P2-S1.translation: 争论的焦点是TMT规划的选址就在莫纳克亚山上——这是一座休眠火山，被一些夏威夷人尊奉为“脐带”，连接着夏威夷群岛与天空。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P2-S1.text: At issue is the TMT's planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P2-S1.translation: 争论的焦点是TMT规划的选址就在莫纳克亚山上——这是一座休眠火山，被一些夏威夷人尊奉为“脐带”，连接着夏威夷群岛与天空。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P2-S2.text: But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P2-S2.translation: 但是，莫纳克亚山也是世界上一些最强大的望远镜的所在地。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P2-S2.text: But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes.

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P2-S3.text: Rested in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P2-S3.translation: 莫纳克亚山坐落于太平洋，其顶峰高耸于地球大部分稠密的大气层之上，那里的条件使得望远镜能够获得无与伦比的清晰图像。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P2-S3.text: Rested in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P3-S1.text: Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new.

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P3-S1.text: Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new.

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P3-S2.text: A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P3-S2.translation: 一个由夏威夷人和环境保护主义者组成的人数不多、但却敢于直言的群体，一直以来都把它们的存在视为对圣地的亵渎以及对曾经的主权国家被占领的痛苦回忆。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S1.text: Yet science has a cultural history, too, with roots going back to the dawn of civilization.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S1.translation: 然而，科学也有文化历史，其根源可以追溯到文明的开端。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S2.text: The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii's shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S2.translation: 探寻地平线之外世界的好奇心最初将早期的波利尼西亚人带到了夏威夷海岸，正是同样的好奇心现在又激励着当今的天文学家探索天空。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S2.text: The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii's shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S2.translation: 探寻地平线之外世界的好奇心最初将早期的波利尼西亚人带到了夏威夷海岸，正是同样的好奇心现在又激励着当今的天文学家探索天空。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S3.text: Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S3.translation: 拆除莫纳克亚山上所有望远镜或者禁止在那里进一步开发的呼吁忽视了这一现实，就是天文学和夏威夷文化都试图回答几个重大的问题：我们是谁，从何而来以及要去往何处。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S3.text: Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S3.translation: 拆除莫纳克亚山上所有望远镜或者禁止在那里进一步开发的呼吁忽视了这一现实，就是天文学和夏威夷文化都试图回答几个重大的问题：我们是谁，从何而来以及要去往何处。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S4.text: Perhaps that is why we explore the starry skies, as if answering a primal calling to know ourselves and our true ancestral homes.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P5-S4.translation: 或许这就是我们探索星空的原因，仿佛是在回应了解我们自己和我们祖先真正家园的召唤。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S1.text: The astronomy community is making compromises to change its use of Mauna Kea.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S1.translation: 天文学界正在改变对莫纳克亚山的使用而做出妥协。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S1.text: The astronomy community is making compromises to change its use of Mauna Kea.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S1.translation: 天文学界正在改变对莫纳克亚山的使用而做出妥协。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S2.text: The TMT site was chosen to minimize the telescope's visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental impact.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S2.translation: TMT建造地点的选择最大程度地降低望远镜在岛屿四周的能见度来避免对考古和环境造成影响。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S2.text: The TMT site was chosen to minimize the telescope's visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental impact.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S2.translation: TMT建造地点的选择最大程度地降低望远镜在岛屿四周的能见度来避免对考古和环境造成影响。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S3.text: To limit the number of telescopes on Mauna Kea, old ones will be removed at the end of their lifetimes and their sites returned to their natural state.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S3.translation: 为了限制莫纳克亚山上望远镜数量，旧望远镜在达到使用年限之后将会被拆除，它们原先所在的地址也会被恢复到自然状态。

ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S4.text: More has to be done, but these are good steps in the right direction.
ky-en1-2017-r-t2#P6-S4.translation: 尽管还需要做更多工作，但这些都是朝正确方向迈出的坚实步伐。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P1-S1.text: Robert F. Kennedy once said that a country's GDP measures "everything except that which makes life worthwhile."
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P1-S1.translation: 罗伯特·F·肯尼迪曾经说过，一个国家的国内生产总值（GDP）可以衡量“一切，除了令人生真正有价值的东西”。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P1-S1.text: Robert F. Kennedy once said that a country's GDP measures "everything except that which makes life worthwhile."
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P1-S1.translation: 罗伯特·F·肯尼迪曾经说过，一个国家的国内生产总值（GDP）可以衡量“一切，除了令人生真正有价值的东西”。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P1-S2.text: With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P1-S2.translation: 随着英国公投决定脱离欧盟，且GDP也已断定将因之下滑，此时正是考量其话语所指的最佳时机。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P1-S2.text: With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P1-S2.translation: 随着英国公投决定脱离欧盟，且GDP也已断定将因之下滑，此时正是考量其话语所指的最佳时机。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S1.text: The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S1.translation: GDP及其效用问题已困扰政策制定者们超过半个世纪。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S1.text: The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S1.translation: GDP及其效用问题已困扰政策制定者们超过半个世纪。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S2.text: Many argue that it is a flawed concept. It measures things that do not matter and misses things that do.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 很多人坚称这是个有缺陷的概念。它衡量并不重要的东西，却遗漏了真正重要的东西。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S2.text: Many argue that it is a flawed concept. It measures things that do not matter and misses things that do.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S2.translation: 很多人坚称这是个有缺陷的概念。它衡量并不重要的东西，却遗漏了真正重要的东西。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S3.text: By most recent measures, the UK's GDP has been the envy of the Western world, with record low unemployment and high growth figures.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S3.translation: 根据最新的测量标准，英国的GDP一直是西方世界羡慕的对象，有着有史以来最低的失业率和最高的增长值。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S3.text: By most recent measures, the UK's GDP has been the envy of the Western world, with record low unemployment and high growth figures.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S3.translation: 根据最新的测量标准，英国的GDP一直是西方世界羡慕的对象，有着有史以来最低的失业率和最高的增长值。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S4.text: If everything was going so well, then why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit, despite the warnings about what it could do to their country's economic prospects?
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P2-S4.translation: 倘若一切都进展得如此喜人，那为何尽管已有警示表明脱欧将会影响本国经济，还是有1700多万人投票支持脱欧？

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S1.text: A recent annual study of countries and their ability to convert growth into well-being sheds some light on that question.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S1.translation: 最近一项关于“不同国家及其将增长转化为人民幸福的能力”的年度研究给上述问题提供了些许解释。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S1.text: A recent annual study of countries and their ability to convert growth into well-being sheds some light on that question.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S1.translation: 最近一项关于“不同国家及其将增长转化为人民幸福的能力”的年度研究给上述问题提供了些许解释。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S2.text: Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S2.translation: 在所有被测量的163个国家中，英国是在“确保经济增长转化为有意义的民生改善”方面表现最差的国家之一。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S2.text: Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S2.translation: 在所有被测量的163个国家中，英国是在“确保经济增长转化为有意义的民生改善”方面表现最差的国家之一。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S3.text: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S3.translation: 此次研究并非只关注GDP，而是涵盖了健康、教育和公民社会参与度领域的40多组不同指标，意在对各国表现做出更全面的评估。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S3.text: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P3-S3.translation: 此次研究并非只关注GDP，而是涵盖了健康、教育和公民社会参与度领域的40多组不同指标，意在对各国表现做出更全面的评估。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S1.text: While all of these countries face their own challenges, there are a number of consistent themes.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S1.translation: 尽管所有这些国家都面临着各自的挑战，但仍存在许多一致的问题。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S1.text: While all of these countries face their own challenges, there are a number of consistent themes.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S1.translation: 尽管所有这些国家都面临着各自的挑战，但仍存在许多一致的问题。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S2.text: Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S2.translation: 的确，自2008年全球危机以来，经济已经有了复苏的苗头；但就健康和教育这类领域的关键指标而言，主要经济体的表现持续下滑。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S3.text: Yet this isn't the case with all countries.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S3.translation: 然而，并非所有国家都是如此。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S3.text: Yet this isn't the case with all countries.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S3.translation: 然而，并非所有国家都是如此。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S4.text: Some relatively poor European countries have seen huge improvements across measures including civil society, income equality and the environment.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S4.translation: 一些相对贫困的欧洲国家在包括公民社会、收入平等和环境等诸多方面的指标上都有巨大的提升。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S4.text: Some relatively poor European countries have seen huge improvements across measures including civil society, income equality and the environment.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P4-S4.translation: 一些相对贫困的欧洲国家在包括公民社会、收入平等和环境等诸多方面的指标上都有巨大的提升。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P5-S1.text: This is a lesson that rich countries can learn: When GDP is no longer regarded as the sole measure of a country's success, the world looks very different.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P5-S1.translation: 这是一条富裕国家可以吸取的教训：当GDP不再被当作衡量国家成功与否的唯一标准时，那世界看起来就大不相同了。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P5-S1.text: This is a lesson that rich countries can learn: When GDP is no longer regarded as the sole measure of a country's success, the world looks very different.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P5-S1.translation: 这是一条富裕国家可以吸取的教训：当GDP不再被当作衡量国家成功与否的唯一标准时，那世界看起来就大不相同了。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P6-S1.text: So, what Kennedy was referring to was that while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations, as a measure, it is no longer enough.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P6-S1.translation: 因此，肯尼迪所要指的是：尽管GDP一直是衡量国家经济活动最常用的方法，但作为一种衡量标准，它已不足以担此重任。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P6-S1.text: So, what Kennedy was referring to was that while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations, as a measure, it is no longer enough.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P6-S1.translation: 因此，肯尼迪所要指的是：尽管GDP一直是衡量国家经济活动最常用的方法，但作为一种衡量标准，它已不足以担此重任。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P6-S2.text: It does not include important factors such as environmental quality or education outcomes—all things that contribute to a person's sense of well-being.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P6-S2.translation: 它并不包含环境质量和教育成果等重要因素——所有那些能提供个人幸福感的因素。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P6-S2.text: It does not include important factors such as environmental quality or education outcomes—all things that contribute to a person's sense of well-being.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P6-S2.translation: 它并不包含环境质量和教育成果等重要因素——所有那些能提供个人幸福感的因素。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P7-S1.text: The sharp hit to growth predicted around the world and in the UK could lead to a decline in the everyday services we depend on for our well-being and for growth.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P7-S1.translation: 据预测，世界范围内和英国的经济增长都将遭受重创，而这可能会导致我们提升幸福感和促进个人发展所依赖的日常服务（水平）下降。

ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P7-S2.text: But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.
ky-en1-2017-r-t3#P7-S2.translation: 但，政策制定者们应重新集中精力于提升（社会）福利，而非仅仅忧心GDP数字；如此才有可能避免预期的灾难，甚至取得进步。
